name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna
department: Higher and Technical Education Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Students from Economically Backward Classes (EBC)
description: Tuition fee and exam fee concession provided to economically weaker students admitted to government-approved professional and non-professional higher education courses in Maharashtra colleges.
eligibility: Annual family income must not exceed INR 8,00,000. Candidate must be a resident/domicile of Maharashtra. Admitted through CAP round for professional technical courses (Engineering, Pharmacy, MBA, Architecture, etc.). Minimum 50% attendance.
benefits: 50% reimbursement of tuition fees and exam fees in government-aided, semi-aided, and un-aided private higher education colleges and institutes.
required_documents: Maharashtra Domicile Certificate, Family Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar, Previous year marksheet, CAP Allotment Letter, College Fee Receipt, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook linked to Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply online through the MahaDBT scholarship portal (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in). Fill in personal and academic details, upload scanned documents, select college and course, and submit before deadline.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste (SC) Students
department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: SC and Neo-Buddhist Students
description: Centrally sponsored and state-supported scholarship scheme providing comprehensive financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying in post-matriculation or post-secondary classes.
eligibility: Student must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) or Navbouddha category. Domiciled in Maharashtra. Annual family income from all sources must not exceed INR 2,50,000. Enrolled in recognized 11th, 12th, diploma, degree, postgraduate, or PhD courses.
benefits: 100% tuition and examination fee waiver, monthly maintenance allowance ranging from INR 230 to INR 1200 per month depending on day-scholar or hosteller status, study tour charges, and book grant.
required_documents: Caste Certificate, Caste Validity Certificate, Tahsildar Income Certificate, Domicile Certificate, 10th/12th Marksheets, Aadhaar Linked Bank Account, Ration Card.
application_procedure: Register on the MahaDBT portal, navigate to Social Justice department, submit Post-Matric SC scholarship application with verified documents.

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
target_beneficiaries: Meritorious College and University Students
description: Financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet part of their day-to-day educational expenses while pursuing graduate and postgraduate studies.
eligibility: Students above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream from respective Class 12th State Board / CBSE / CISCE. Family income less than INR 4,50,000 per annum. Regular full-time students.
benefits: INR 12,000 per annum at graduation level for first 3 years and INR 20,000 per annum at post-graduation level disbursed directly via DBT into bank accounts.
required_documents: Class 12th passing marksheet, Family Income Certificate, Aadhaar Card, College Bonafide Certificate, Bank Passbook.
application_procedure: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) (scholarships.gov.in). Complete OTR registration, select Central Sector Scheme, and submit for institute verification.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education
target_beneficiaries: Girl Students Pursuing Technical Degree / Diploma
description: Government scheme to encourage young women to pursue technical education (Degree and Diploma in Engineering, Technology, Architecture, and Pharmacy) in AICTE-approved institutions.
eligibility: Female students admitted to 1st year of Degree or Diploma course or 2nd year through lateral entry in AICTE approved institution. Maximum two girls per family. Family income below INR 8,00,000 per annum.
benefits: INR 50,000 per year for every year of study towards college fee payment, computer/laptop purchase, books, stationery, and equipment.
required_documents: AICTE Admission Proof, 10th/12th Marksheet, Income Certificate, Domicile/Residence Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Self-declaration of family with one/two girl children.
application_procedure: Online application via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP). Institutional verification followed by state and AICTE approval.

name: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Vastigruh Nirvah Bhatta Yojna (Hostel Maintenance Allowance)
department: Higher and Technical Education Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Children of Registered Small/Marginal Farmers and Low-Income Families
description: Hostel maintenance allowance for children of registered small landholding farmers and low-income families studying professional courses in Maharashtra.
eligibility: Students enrolled in professional courses (Engineering, Medical, Architecture, Agriculture). Children of registered marginal farmers (Alpabhudharak) or family income below INR 1,00,000 / INR 8,00,000. Must reside in hostel or rented accommodation outside hometown.
benefits: INR 30,000 per academic year in Mumbai, Pune, Nagpur, Aurangabad metro areas, and INR 20,000 per academic year in other district cities for hostel/mess living expenses.
required_documents: 7/12 Land Extract or Marginal Farmer Certificate, Income Certificate, Hostel Admission Receipt or Registered Rent Agreement, College Bonafide, Maharashtra Domicile.
application_procedure: Apply on the MahaDBT portal under the Directorate of Higher/Technical Education hostel allowance scheme section.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
department: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education
target_beneficiaries: Meritorious School Students of Class 9 to 12 from Low-Income Families
description: Scholarship awarded to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest dropout at class VIII and encourage them to continue secondary education up to class XII.
eligibility: Students studying in Class 8 in government/local body schools having scored minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST). Selection through state NMMS examination. Parental income less than INR 3,50,000 per annum.
benefits: INR 12,000 per year (INR 1,000 per month) from Class 9 to Class 12 deposited into student's bank account via DBT.
required_documents: Class 8 marksheet, Income Certificate, Caste Certificate (if applicable), Aadhaar Card, State NMMS selection rank card.
application_procedure: State education board conducts selection test; selected candidates register and verify on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: Savitribai Phule Scholarship for VJNT and SBC Girl Students
department: VJNT, OBC and SBC Welfare Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: VJNT and SBC Girl Students in Class 5 to 10
description: Incentive scholarship scheme to motivate girls belonging to Vimukta Jati, Nomadic Tribes (VJNT), and Special Backward Classes (SBC) to complete primary and secondary education.
eligibility: Girl students studying in recognized government or aided schools from Class 5th to Class 10th. Belonging to VJNT or SBC communities. No family income limit applies for this school incentive.
benefits: Financial stipend of INR 100 per month for 10 months (INR 1,000 per academic year) for Class 5 to 7, and INR 150 per month for Class 8 to 10.
required_documents: Caste Certificate of student or parent, School Bonafide Certificate, Previous year marksheet, Aadhaar Card, Bank account passbook.
application_procedure: Schools submit student rosters directly or students apply through MahaDBT portal under VJNT OBC SBC Welfare department.

name: PM-YASASVI Scholarship Scheme for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
target_beneficiaries: OBC, EBC, and Nomadic Tribe Students in Top Schools
description: Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India (YASASVI) offering top-class school education scholarships for OBC, EBC, and De-notified Nomadic Tribes.
eligibility: Students studying in Class 9 or Class 11 in identified Top-Class schools across India. Family income should not exceed INR 2,50,000 per annum.
benefits: INR 75,000 per annum for Class 9 and 10 students; INR 1,25,000 per annum for Class 11 and 12 students covering school tuition fees and hostel charges.
required_documents: OBC/EBC/DNT Certificate, Income Certificate, School ID and Bonafide, Previous Class Marksheet, Aadhaar Card.
application_procedure: Apply via National Scholarship Portal (NSP) under PM-YASASVI scheme tab.

name: State Minority Scholarship for Higher and Professional Courses
department: Minority Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Religious Minority Students (Muslim, Christian, Buddhist, Sikh, Parsi, Jain, Jewish)
description: Scholarship for pursuing higher and technical education (Medical, Dental, Engineering, Architecture, Pharmacy, Law, BCA, MCA, MBA) for religious minority communities in Maharashtra.
eligibility: Resident of Maharashtra. Belongs to registered minority community (Muslim, Buddhist, Christian, Sikh, Parsi, Jain, Jew). Admitted to recognized professional degree/diploma course. Family income under INR 8,00,000 per year.
benefits: Financial aid up to INR 50,000 per academic year or actual tuition fee, whichever is lower.
required_documents: Minority Self-Declaration, Maharashtra Domicile, Tahsildar Income Certificate, Marksheet, College Fee Receipt, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Online application via MahaDBT portal under Minority Development Department tab.

name: Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Students
department: Higher Education Department
target_beneficiaries: Undergraduate and Postgraduate General / Economically Weaker Students
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship providing financial relief to deserving students from economically constrained families pursuing degree and master courses in Arts, Science, Commerce, and Technology.
eligibility: Minimum 60% aggregate in 12th board exams for degree level or 53% in graduation for master's level. Annual household income below INR 2,50,000.
benefits: INR 1,000 to INR 5,000 per month depending on level of study and course discipline.
required_documents: Income Certificate, Board Examination Marksheet, College Admission Receipt, Aadhaar, Bank Account details.
application_procedure: Apply online on the respective higher education portal with validated marksheets and income certificates.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture, Government of India
target_beneficiaries: Small, Marginal, and Landholding Farmers
description: Direct Income Support scheme providing assured financial assistance to all landholding farmer families across India to supplement their financial needs for procuring agricultural inputs and domestic needs.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families having cultivable agricultural land in their names (subject to exclusion criteria such as institutional landholders, income tax payees, and constitutional post holders). Aadhaar-seeded bank account and e-KYC mandatory.
benefits: INR 6,000 per year transferred in three equal four-monthly installments of INR 2,000 directly into the bank accounts of farmers via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
required_documents: Land Ownership Record (7/12 Extract, Khatiyan, Record of Rights), Aadhaar Card, Active Bank Account Passbook, Mobile Number linked with Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Self-registration on the PM-KISAN web portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or through local Common Service Centers (CSC) / Agriculture Department village nodal officers.

name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana (Maharashtra)
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Farmer Beneficiaries of PM-KISAN in Maharashtra
description: Maharashtra State Government top-up scheme supplementing PM-KISAN by providing an additional annual grant of INR 6,000 to eligible farmers in Maharashtra.
eligibility: Must be an active and verified beneficiary of PM-KISAN in Maharashtra with land ownership registered in Maharashtra and completed e-KYC.
benefits: Additional INR 6,000 per year in three installments of INR 2,000, bringing total farmer direct assistance to INR 12,000 annually when combined with PM-KISAN.
required_documents: PM-KISAN Registration ID, Maharashtra 7/12 Land Record, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account seeded with NPCI/Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Automatically linked with the verified PM-KISAN state registry. Farmers verify status on the Krishi Maharashtra portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
target_beneficiaries: All Farmers Growing Notified Crops (Food crops, Oilseeds, Commercial crops)
description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme providing financial support and claim settlement to farmers suffering crop loss or damage arising out of natural calamities, pests, drought, and floods. In Maharashtra, crop insurance is offered to farmers for just INR 1.
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas. Non-loanee and loanee farmers are both eligible.
benefits: Comprehensive risk insurance from pre-sowing to post-harvest loss. Farmer premium capped at 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and in Maharashtra, state government pays the remainder so farmers pay only INR 1.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, 7/12 Land Record Extract, 8A Extract, Sowing Certificate (Pik Pahani / Sowing Declaration), Bank Passbook copy.
application_procedure: Apply on the PMFBY portal (pmfby.gov.in), Aaple Sarkar CSC center, or bank branches before the cut-off sowing notification date.

name: Mukhyamantri Saur Krushi Vahini Yojana (MSKVY 2.0)
department: Energy Department / MSEDCL, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Farmers Requiring Daytime Electricity for Irrigation
description: Flagship solar feeder program of Maharashtra designed to solarize agricultural feeders, ensuring reliable, uninterrupted daytime electricity power supply for irrigation to farmers across the state.
eligibility: Farmers connected to agricultural feeders in rural Maharashtra. Also open to farmers willing to lease barren or cultivable agricultural land to solar developers for annual lease rental income.
benefits: Guaranteed 8 hours of reliable daytime three-phase power supply for farm water pumps; farmers leasing land earn guaranteed annual lease rental of INR 50,000+ per acre with periodic escalation.
required_documents: Agricultural electricity consumer connection number, 7/12 Land Extract, Identity Proof.
application_procedure: Feeder solarization executed through MSEDCL / MahaUrja. Land lease applications submitted online via MSKVY portal.

name: PM KUSUM - Component B: Standalone Solar Agriculture Pumps
department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) / MEDA Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Individual Farmers in Off-Grid Areas
description: Installation of standalone off-grid solar-powered agriculture water pumps to replace diesel pumps and provide assured green irrigation in grid-deficit agricultural regions.
eligibility: Individual farmers, water user associations, and farmer producer organizations without grid electricity or replacing diesel pump sets. Land with assured water source (borewell/well).
benefits: Up to 90% subsidy on solar pump cost (30% Central grant, 60% Maharashtra State subsidy via MEDA/MahaVitaran); farmer contributes only 10% for 3 HP, 5 HP, or 7.5 HP solar pumps.
required_documents: 7/12 Extract showing water source, Well/Borewell NOC, Aadhaar Card, Caste Certificate (if SC/ST for priority), Bank details.
application_procedure: Register and apply online on the MahaUrja / MEDA portal (kusum.mahaurja.com).

name: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana
department: Agriculture Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste (SC) and Navbouddha Farmers
description: Special component irrigation scheme for SC farmers in Maharashtra to establish irrigation facilities, wells, farm ponds, and power connections to increase crop productivity and self-reliance.
eligibility: Farmer must belong to SC/Navbouddha category in Maharashtra. Annual family income up to INR 1,50,000. Must own agricultural land between 0.40 to 6 hectares with water source feasibility.
benefits: Financial grant up to INR 2,50,000 for digging a new well, INR 50,000 for in-well boring, INR 25,000 for electric/solar pump set, and subsidies for micro-irrigation (drip/sprinkler).
required_documents: Caste Certificate, 7/12 & 8A Land extracts, Tahsildar Income Certificate, Water availability certificate from groundwater survey, Bank Passbook.
application_procedure: Apply online through the MahaDBT Farmer Portal (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer).

name: Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Yojana (PoCRA)
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra / World Bank
target_beneficiaries: Small and Marginal Farmers in Drought-Prone and Climate-Vulnerable Villages
description: Climate-resilient agriculture project implemented across 5,000+ vulnerable villages in Marathwada, Vidarbha, and Jalgaon to enhance water security, soil health, and farming profitability.
eligibility: Farmers residing in notified project villages across 15 districts of Maharashtra. Priority to small/marginal farmers, women farmers, and SC/ST farmers.
benefits: Direct financial subsidies (up to 75% for small/marginal farmers) for farm ponds, drip irrigation, shade-net houses, polyhouses, sericulture, goat rearing, and seed production.
required_documents: Village Domicile Proof, 7/12 Land Extract, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account linked to DBT.
application_procedure: Register on the Mahapocra portal or mobile application (mahapocra.gov.in) and apply under desired agricultural component.

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM / MahaDBT Krishi Yantrikikaran)
department: Ministry of Agriculture / Department of Agriculture Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Farmers Purchasing Farm Machinery and Implements
description: Financial subsidy to encourage farm mechanization among small and marginal farmers to improve crop productivity, save labor costs, and streamline agricultural operations.
eligibility: All landholding farmers in Maharashtra. Women, SC, ST, and small/marginal farmers receive higher subsidy percentages.
benefits: 40% to 50% capital subsidy (up to INR 1,25,000 on tractors, power tillers, rotavators, multi-crop threshers, and harvesting machinery).
required_documents: 7/12 Land Record, 8A Extract, Aadhaar Card, Machinery Quotation from authorized dealer, Bank Passbook, Caste Certificate if applicable.
application_procedure: Apply online on the MahaDBT Krishi Yantrikikaran portal. Beneficiaries chosen via computerized lottery system.

name: Gopinath Munde Shetkari Apghat Vima Yojana (Accident Insurance Scheme)
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Registered Landholding Farmers in Maharashtra
description: Universal accident compensation and financial insurance support for landholding farmers and their family members in case of accidental death or permanent disability.
eligibility: All farmers having their names registered in 7/12 land records in Maharashtra between the ages of 10 and 75 years.
benefits: INR 2,00,000 ex-gratia compensation in case of accidental death or loss of two limbs/eyes; INR 1,00,000 for permanent disability involving loss of one limb/eye. Premium is 100% borne by Maharashtra Government.
required_documents: FIR / Police Inquest Panchnama, Post-mortem Report, Death Certificate, 7/12 Land Extract, Legal Heir Certificate.
application_procedure: Claim submitted within 30 days of accident to Taluka Agriculture Officer (TAO) or District Agriculture Officer.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
department: Department of Agriculture / Reserve Bank of India & NABARD
target_beneficiaries: Farmers, Dairy Farmers, Fishermen, Animal Husbandry Workers
description: Credit facility providing farmers with timely and hassle-free access to short-term loans for crop cultivation, harvesting, post-harvest expenses, and animal husbandry at subsidized interest rates.
eligibility: All farmers, individual/joint borrowers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers. Extended to dairy and fisheries farmers.
benefits: Credit limit up to INR 3,00,000 at effective subsidized interest rate of 4% per annum (after 2% interest subvention and 3% prompt repayment incentive). Collateral-free loan up to INR 1,60,000.
required_documents: Duly filled KCC application, Land Title Deeds / 7/12 Extract, Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Crop Sowing Plan.
application_procedure: Apply at any rural, commercial, cooperative bank, or through the PM-KISAN online portal.

name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
department: Public Health Department / State Health Assurance Society, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Universal Coverage for All Families Domiciled in Maharashtra
description: Comprehensive cashless health insurance scheme of the Government of Maharashtra providing coverage for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization through an extensive network of empanelled government and private hospitals.
eligibility: Universal coverage for all ration card holders (Yellow, Orange, and White) and families residing in Maharashtra holding valid Maharashtra Ration Card and Aadhaar Card.
benefits: Cashless medical and surgical treatment cover up to INR 5,00,000 per family per year across 1,356 medical and surgical procedures, including ICU care, surgeries, cancer therapy, heart surgery, and kidney dialysis.
required_documents: Maharashtra Ration Card (Yellow/Orange/White), Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Medical diagnosis documents from empanelled hospital.
application_procedure: Direct walk-in to any empanelled hospital. Contact the Arogyamitra at the hospital helpdesk who facilitates online authorization and cashless admission.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
department: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Deprived Rural Families and Identified Urban Worker Households (SECC 2011) + Senior Citizens 70+
description: World's largest government-funded health assurance scheme providing cashless hospital coverage across India. Recently expanded to provide universal INR 5,00,000 cover to all citizens aged 70 and above irrespective of income.
eligibility: Families identified in SECC 2011 deprivation criteria, RSBY cardholders, and all senior citizens aged 70 years and above.
benefits: Cashless health cover of INR 5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization in empanelled public and private hospitals across all Indian states.
required_documents: Ayushman Card / Aadhaar Card, Ration Card, Age proof for 70+ beneficiaries.
application_procedure: Check eligibility on pmjay.gov.in or Ayushman App, generate Ayushman Golden Card at CSC or empanelled hospital, and present at admission.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India
target_beneficiaries: Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM)
description: Maternity Benefit Programme providing cash incentive to pregnant and lactating mothers for wage compensation, nutritious diet, and institutional delivery.
eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for the first living child, and special incentive if the second child is a girl. Not applicable to regular government employees.
benefits: Cash incentive of INR 5,000 in two installments for the first child, and INR 6,000 in a single installment upon the birth of a second girl child directly credited via DBT.
required_documents: Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card, Pregnancy Registration, Aadhaar Card of mother and husband, Bank Passbook linked to Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Register at the local Anganwadi Center (AWC) or nearest government health center or via pmmvy.wcd.gov.in portal.

name: Hinduhridaysamrat Balasaheb Thackeray Aapla Davakhana
department: Public Health Department & Urban Local Bodies, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Urban Slum Dwellers, Commuters, and General Public
description: Neighborhood primary healthcare clinic network set up across Mumbai and Maharashtra urban centers offering free medical consultations, essential diagnostic tests, and medicines.
eligibility: Open to all citizens visiting clinic premises; no documentation or income criteria required for basic consultation.
benefits: Free OPD consultations by MBBS doctors, free essential medicines, and over 140 free clinical diagnostic/pathology laboratory tests (blood, urine, diabetes, liver, kidney tests).
required_documents: Any identity proof or mobile number for OPD registration.
application_procedure: Walk-in directly to the nearest Aapla Davakhana clinic during operating hours (morning and evening shifts).

name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
department: Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India (PMBI), Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers
target_beneficiaries: All Citizens Seeking Affordable Generic Medicines
description: Providing quality generic medicines and surgical consumables at 50% to 90% lower prices than branded commercial equivalents through specialized Jan Aushadhi Kendras.
eligibility: Available to all citizens across India with a valid medical prescription.
benefits: Significant reduction in healthcare out-of-pocket spending on chronic disease medicines (diabetes, hypertension, cardiac care, oncology, antibiotics) and sanitary pads at INR 1 each.
required_documents: Medical prescription from registered medical practitioner.
application_procedure: Locate nearest PMBJP Kendra using the 'Jan Aushadhi Sugam' mobile app and purchase generic medicines directly.

name: Mukhyamantri Sahayata Nidhi (Chief Minister's Medical Relief Fund)
department: Chief Minister's Relief Fund Cell, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Patients Requiring Expensive Critical Illness Treatments
description: Discretionary financial grant assistance for poor patients suffering from life-threatening medical conditions requiring expensive surgeries, bone marrow transplants, cancer care, or heart procedures.
eligibility: Resident of Maharashtra with annual family income up to INR 1,60,000 (INR 1.6 lakh). Hospitalized in recognized charitable or government hospital.
benefits: Direct financial aid up to INR 50,000 to INR 3,00,000 disbursed directly to the treating hospital for surgeries, organ transplants, and emergency medical treatments.
required_documents: Hospital Cost Estimation Certificate signed by civil surgeon/hospital superintendent, Tahsildar Income Certificate, Maharashtra Ration Card, Aadhaar Card.
application_procedure: Apply online at cmrf.maharashtra.gov.in or submit physical application to Chief Minister Medical Relief Fund Cell, Mantralaya, Mumbai.

name: National Tuberculosis Elimination Program - Nikshay Poshan Yojana
department: Central TB Division, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: All Notified Tuberculosis (TB) Patients
description: Direct financial incentive to support nutritional requirements of tuberculosis patients undergoing treatment until cure.
eligibility: All TB patients notified on the national Ni-kshay web portal undergoing active DOTS or anti-TB treatment regimen.
benefits: INR 1,000 per month (recently enhanced from INR 500) directly credited to the patient's bank account for nutritional food support during treatment period.
required_documents: Ni-kshay Registration ID, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details (DBT enabled).
application_procedure: Enrolled automatically upon diagnosis and registration at any government health center or participating private doctor on nikshay.in.

name: National Sickle Cell Anemia Elimination Mission
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / Tribal Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Tribal and Vulnerable Population in Notified Districts (Gadchiroli, Nandurbar, etc.)
description: Comprehensive mission to eliminate sickle cell anemia through universal screening, genetic counseling, prevention, and clinical management.
eligibility: Tribal and vulnerable citizens aged 0-40 years residing in affected districts across Maharashtra and Central India.
benefits: Free universal screening, Sickle Cell Status Genetic Card, free Hydroxyurea medicine supply, and disability pensions for severe patients.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Community Certificate, Sickle Cell Test Card.
application_procedure: Screening organized at schools, Anganwadis, and primary health centers (PHC) across tribal belts.

name: Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN)
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
target_beneficiaries: BPL Patients Suffering from Major Life-Threatening Diseases
description: One-time financial assistance to below-poverty-line patients suffering from major life-threatening diseases receiving treatment at super-speciality government hospitals / AIIMS.
eligibility: Patients living below poverty line (BPL) receiving treatment in government AIIMS or designated central hospitals. Not covered by Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY.
benefits: Financial assistance up to INR 15,00,000 for specialized procedures (cancer treatment, rare diseases, organ transplants).
required_documents: BPL Ration Card, Income Certificate, Medical Estimate and Verification from Medical Superintendent of treating hospital.
application_procedure: Application submitted via the Medical Superintendent of the empanelled central government hospital to the Ministry.

name: Mission Indradhanush (Intensified Immunization Program)
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Children Under 2 Years of Age and Pregnant Women
description: Universal immunization program ensuring complete vaccination against 12 vaccine-preventable diseases for all unreached children and pregnant mothers.
eligibility: All infants and children up to 2 years and pregnant women who have missed routine vaccine doses.
benefits: Free vaccination against Diphtheria, Whooping Cough, Tetanus, Polio, Measles, Rubella, Severe Childhood TB, Hepatitis B, Rotavirus, and Pneumococcal infections.
required_documents: MCP Card / Mother Child Tracking Card or Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Direct participation at local Anganwadi, Primary Health Center (PHC), or special Mission Indradhanush vaccination camps.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra)
department: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Underprivileged Women Aged 21 to 65 Years in Maharashtra
description: Flagship cash transfer scheme empowering women across Maharashtra by providing assured monthly financial support for nutrition, self-reliance, and health.
eligibility: Resident woman of Maharashtra aged between 21 and 65 years. Annual family income must not exceed INR 2,50,000 (Yellow and Orange ration card holders exempt from separate income certificate). Must have an Aadhaar-linked active bank account.
benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) of INR 1,500 per month (INR 18,000 annually) transferred directly to the beneficiary woman's bank account.
required_documents: Maharashtra Domicile Certificate or 15-year Ration Card / School Leaving Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Yellow or Orange Ration Card, Bank Passbook, Hamipatra (Self-declaration).
application_procedure: Apply online via the Nari Shakti Doot mobile application or Aaple Sarkar portal or Anganwadi workers / Setu Seva Kendras.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
department: Department of Posts / Ministry of Finance, Government of India
target_beneficiaries: Girl Children Below 10 Years of Age
description: High-interest government-backed small savings scheme designed specifically for parents of girl children to build a dedicated education and marriage corpus.
eligibility: Account opened in the name of a girl child by natural or legal guardian anytime from birth until she attains the age of 10 years. Maximum two accounts per family (three in case of twins/triplets).
benefits: Attractive sovereign interest rate (currently 8.2% p.a., compounded annually), tax-free interest, and Section 80C income tax deduction up to INR 1,50,000 per year. Maturity period of 21 years with partial withdrawal allowed at age 18 for higher education.
required_documents: Girl Child Birth Certificate, Guardian Identity Proof (Aadhaar/PAN), Address Proof, Passport size photographs.
application_procedure: Open account at any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch with initial deposit of INR 250.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY 2.0)
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India
target_beneficiaries: Adult Women Belonging to Poor / BPL Households
description: Providing clean cooking fuel (LPG connections) to adult women of poor households to replace hazardous biomass fuels, reduce respiratory illnesses, and promote women's health.
eligibility: Adult woman (aged 18+) belonging to SC, ST, PM Awas Yojana beneficiary, forest dwellers, most backward classes, or poor households verified through 14-point declaration. No existing LPG connection in household.
benefits: Free LPG connection with deposit-free cylinder, regulator, safety hose, and free first cylinder refill and gas stove. Ongoing targeted subsidy of INR 300 per 14.2 kg cylinder for up to 12 refills a year.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of applicant woman, Ration Card proving family composition, Bank Account linked to Aadhaar, Address Proof.
application_procedure: Apply at local LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, HP Gas) or submit online via pmuy.gov.in portal.

name: Mukhyamantri Annapurna Yojana (Free LPG Cylinders in Maharashtra)
department: Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Protection Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Eligible Families Under PM Ujjwala and Ladki Bahin in Maharashtra
description: Maharashtra State scheme offering 3 free LPG domestic gas cylinder refills per year to eligible households headed by women.
eligibility: Beneficiary families under Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) or families of eligible beneficiaries under Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana holding valid domestic LPG connection.
benefits: 100% cost reimbursement for 3 domestic LPG gas cylinders (14.2 kg) per year directly credited to the woman's bank account via DBT.
required_documents: LPG Gas Consumer Number and Passbook, Aadhaar Card, Ration Card, Bank Account linked to DBT.
application_procedure: Beneficiary data linked through oil marketing companies and state DBT portal. Verified consumers receive automated refill reimbursement.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme for Women and SC/ST Entrepreneurs
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: Women and SC/ST Entrepreneurs Setting Up Greenfield Ventures
description: Facilitating bank loans between INR 10 lakh and INR 1 crore to at least one woman and one SC/ST borrower per commercial bank branch for establishing greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, or trading.
eligibility: Woman entrepreneur or SC/ST applicant aged 18+. In case of non-individual enterprises, 51% shareholding must be held by the woman or SC/ST promoter. Greenfield project (first-time business).
benefits: Bank composite loan (term loan + working capital) covering up to 85% of project cost between INR 10,00,000 and INR 1,00,00,000 at lowest applicable interest rates.
required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR), Identity and Address Proof, Promoter Caste/Category/Gender declaration, Business entity registration, Bank statement.
application_procedure: Apply on the Stand-Up India portal (standupmitra.in) or approach any scheduled commercial bank branch.

name: Navtejaswini Maharashtra Rural Women Enterprise Scheme
department: Mahila Arthik Vikas Mahamandal (MAVIM) / IFAD, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Rural Women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) and Micro-Enterprises
description: Poverty reduction and women empowerment initiative supporting rural women SHGs with access to finance, market linkages, and enterprise creation.
eligibility: Members of registered women Self-Help Groups (Bachat Gat) in rural Maharashtra certified by MAVIM.
benefits: Subsidized seed capital loans, technical training, digital marketing support, and cluster-level value addition units for food processing and handicrafts.
required_documents: SHG Registration Certificate, Bank Account Details, Member Aadhaar Cards, Resolution of SHG.
application_procedure: Apply through the local Community Managed Resource Centers (CMRC) or MAVIM district coordinators.

name: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC)
department: Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: All Girls and Women
description: Special sovereign small savings deposit scheme designed to encourage savings culture and financial security among women.
eligibility: Account opened by a woman for herself or by a guardian on behalf of a minor girl child.
benefits: Attractive fixed interest rate of 7.5% per annum compounded quarterly on deposits up to INR 2,00,000 for a 2-year tenure. Partial withdrawal up to 40% allowed after 1 year.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Account Opening Form, Passport Photos.
application_procedure: Open account at any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matritva Suraksha Abhiyan (PMSMA)
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Pregnant Women in 2nd and 3rd Trimesters
description: Assured, comprehensive, and quality antenatal care (ANC) services provided to pregnant women on the 9th of every month across India by medical specialists.
eligibility: All pregnant women in their 2nd or 3rd trimesters.
benefits: Free specialized antenatal checkup, ultrasound sonography, blood hemoglobin, blood pressure, high-risk pregnancy identification, and iron-folic acid medicines on the 9th day of each month.
required_documents: MCP Card, Aadhaar Card.
application_procedure: Visit any government primary health center, sub-district hospital, or civil hospital on the 9th of every month.

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Karya Prashikshan Yojana (Maharashtra Youth Internship Scheme)
department: Skills, Employment, Entrepreneurship and Innovation Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed Educated Youth Aged 18 to 35 in Maharashtra
description: On-the-job apprenticeship and practical industrial training scheme for unemployed youth to bridge the gap between academic education and industry skill requirements.
eligibility: Youth aged 18 to 35 years residing in Maharashtra. Educational qualification: 12th pass, ITI, Diploma, Degree (BA, B.Com, B.Sc, BE/B.Tech), or Postgraduate. Registered on the Mahaswayam employment exchange.
benefits: Monthly stipend paid directly by Maharashtra Government: INR 6,000 for 12th Pass, INR 8,000 for ITI/Diploma holders, and INR 10,000 for Graduates/Postgraduates during 6 months of industrial apprenticeship.
required_documents: Educational passing certificates/marksheets, Maharashtra Domicile, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account linked to Aadhaar, Mahaswayam registration number.
application_procedure: Register and apply on the official Mahaswayam web portal (rojgar.mahaswayam.gov.in) under the Yuva Karya Prashikshan tab.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) / NSDC
target_beneficiaries: School/College Dropouts and Unemployed Youth
description: Flagship skill certification scheme of the Government of India enabling Indian youth to take up industry-relevant, market-driven skill training in emerging sectors (AI, Robotics, EV technology, Healthcare, Retail).
eligibility: Any Indian citizen aged 15-45 years with basic education who is unemployed or looking to acquire trade skills. Special focus on school/college dropouts.
benefits: 100% free industry-certified short-term training (STT) and Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL), government certification from Skill India, monetary assessment reward, and placement assistance.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID / Identity proof, Bank Account Details, Highest educational qualification proof.
application_procedure: Search training courses and centers on the Skill India Digital Hub (skillindiadigital.gov.in) and register online.

name: Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP Maharashtra)
department: Industries Directorate, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: First-Generation Micro-Entrepreneurs and Educated Unemployed
description: Credit-linked capital subsidy program of Maharashtra to establish self-employment ventures in manufacturing and service sectors, creating local jobs in rural and urban areas.
eligibility: Age between 18 and 45 years (up to 50 for SC/ST/Women/Ex-servicemen/Divyang). Resident of Maharashtra. Minimum 7th pass for projects up to 10 lakh; minimum 10th pass for projects above 10 lakh. Project cost up to INR 50 lakh for manufacturing and INR 10 lakh for service enterprises.
benefits: Government financial capital subsidy (Margin Money) of 15% to 35% of project cost (up to INR 17.5 lakh) deposited in bank; promoter contribution only 5% to 10%.
required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR), Maharashtra Domicile Certificate, Educational Qualification Certificate, Caste Certificate (if applicable), Aadhaar Card, PAN Card.
application_procedure: Apply online on the MahaCMEGP portal (maha-cmegp.gov.in). District Task Force Committee scrutinizes and recommends to banks.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) / KVIC
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed Individuals, Artisans, and Entrepreneurs
description: Major credit-linked subsidy program aimed at generating self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in non-farm sector.
eligibility: Any individual above 18 years. At least 8th standard pass for projects costing above INR 10 lakh in manufacturing and above INR 5 lakh in services. Maximum project cost INR 50 lakh for manufacturing and INR 20 lakh for service sector.
benefits: Capital subsidy of 15% to 25% for general category and 25% to 35% for special categories (SC/ST/OBC/Women/Minorities/Rural) disbursed via KVIC/banks.
required_documents: Project Profile / DPR, Caste Certificate, Special Category Certificate, Aadhaar, Rural Area Certificate (from Gram Panchayat).
application_procedure: Submit online application through the KVIC PMEGP e-portal (kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal).

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS-2)
department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
target_beneficiaries: Industrial Apprentices and Trade Trainees
description: Promoting apprenticeship training in commercial enterprises by reimbursing part of the stipend paid by employers to apprentices.
eligibility: Candidates aged 14+ years (18 for hazardous occupations) possessing minimum educational qualification for designated or optional trades.
benefits: Direct financial stipend support: Government reimburses 25% of prescribed stipend up to INR 1,500 per month per apprentice directly to the apprentice's bank account via DBT.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Educational Certificate (ITI / 10th / 12th / Degree), Bank Account details.
application_procedure: Register as an apprentice on the national apprenticeship portal (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) and apply for open enterprise training opportunities.

name: Pramod Mahajan Rural Skills Development Center (Maharashtra)
department: Skill Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Rural Youth in Maharashtra Gram Panchayats
description: Establishment of skill development centers across 500+ rural blocks of Maharashtra to impart local employment and self-employment training.
eligibility: Youth aged 18-35 residing in rural Maharashtra gram panchayats seeking employment skills.
benefits: Free training in agriculture technology, logistics, hospitality, mobile repair, drone maintenance, solar installation, and local employment placement drives.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, School Leaving Certificate, Gram Panchayat Residence Proof.
application_procedure: Enroll directly at the nearest block Pramod Mahajan Kaushalya Vikas Kendra or through Mahaswayam portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA), Government of India
target_beneficiaries: Economically Weaker Section (EWS), Low Income Group (LIG), and Middle Income Group (MIG)
description: Flagship urban housing mission providing pucca houses and interest subvention subsidies to urban homeless families and low-to-middle income households across all statutory towns.
eligibility: Beneficiary family must not own a pucca house in any part of India. EWS household annual income up to INR 3,00,000; LIG income up to INR 6,00,000; MIG income up to INR 9,00,000. Domicile / residence in statutory urban municipal area.
benefits: Interest subsidy of 4% on home loans up to INR 25 lakh (subsidy value up to INR 1.80 lakh), or direct central/state construction assistance of up to INR 2,50,000 for Beneficiary-Led Construction (BLC).
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members, Income Certificate, Urban Residence Certificate, Land Title / Ownership Deed (for BLC), Non-ownership affidavit.
application_procedure: Apply online through pmay-urban.gov.in or Citizen Facilitation Centers at local Municipal Corporation / Council offices.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
department: Ministry of Rural Development / Rural Development Department Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Homeless Rural Households and Families Living in Kutcha/Dilapidated Houses
description: Providing financial assistance to rural poor households for the construction of pucca houses with basic amenities including piped drinking water, electricity, and clean cooking fuel.
eligibility: Rural households identified through SECC 2011 deprivation criteria and validated by Gram Sabha. Kutcha house or roofless households.
benefits: Direct financial grant of INR 1,20,000 in plain areas and INR 1,30,000 in hilly/difficult areas for house construction, plus 90-95 person-days of unskilled labor wages under MGNREGA (~INR 24,000) and INR 12,000 for toilet construction under SBM.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account linked to DBT, SECC verification document, MGNREGA Job Card.
application_procedure: Beneficiary list prepared by Gram Panchayat via AwaasSoft (awaassoft.nic.in); geotagging of house stages carried out by village officers.

name: Ramai Awas Gharkul Yojana (Maharashtra)
department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste (SC) and Navbouddha Families in Maharashtra
description: State housing assistance program providing permanent pucca houses to homeless and kutcha-house dwelling Scheduled Caste and Neo-Buddhist families in rural and urban Maharashtra.
eligibility: Resident of Maharashtra belonging to SC or Navbouddha category. Annual family income up to INR 1,00,000 in rural areas and INR 3,00,000 in urban areas. Must own land or plot for construction.
benefits: Financial grant of INR 1,30,000 to INR 2,50,000 (depending on rural/urban location) directly disbursed in milestone-based installments for house construction.
required_documents: Caste Certificate, Tahsildar Income Certificate, 7/12 Land extract or Urban Property Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.
application_procedure: Apply through the MahaAwas portal or submit physical application to Block Development Officer (BDO) in rural areas or Municipal Chief Officer in urban areas.

name: Shabari Awas Gharkul Yojana (Maharashtra Tribal Housing)
department: Tribal Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Scheduled Tribe (ST) Families in Maharashtra
description: Housing assistance initiative providing pucca homes to landholding and landless tribal families residing in hilly, forest, and rural areas of Maharashtra.
eligibility: Belongs to Scheduled Tribe (ST) category in Maharashtra. Annual family income up to INR 1,00,000. Homeless or living in thatched/kutcha huts.
benefits: Financial assistance of INR 1,30,000 to INR 1,50,000 for house construction with toilet, plus financial grant of INR 50,000 for purchasing land for landless tribal families.
required_documents: Tribe / Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, Domicile Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Land record or Gram Panchayat plot allocation certificate.
application_procedure: Apply via Tribal Development Project Office (ITDP) or MahaAwas portal.

name: PM SVANidhi (PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
target_beneficiaries: Urban Street Vendors, Hawkers, Thelewale
description: Micro-credit facility enabling urban street vendors to access affordable working capital loans to restart and expand their livelihood after economic shocks.
eligibility: Street vendors vending in urban areas possessing Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies or identified in ULB survey.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan starting at INR 10,000 (1st tranche), escalating to INR 20,000 (2nd tranche) and INR 50,000 (3rd tranche) upon timely repayment. 7% interest subsidy credited directly to bank account, and up to INR 1,200 annual cashback on digital transactions.
required_documents: Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from ULB/Municipality, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details.
application_procedure: Apply online on the PM SVANidhi portal (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in) or via local municipal ward office.

name: Modi Awas Gharkul Yojana (Maharashtra OBC Housing)
department: OBC, VJNT, and SBC Welfare Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Other Backward Class (OBC) Beneficiaries in Maharashtra
description: Special state housing scheme aimed at constructing 10 lakh pucca houses over three years for economically underprivileged OBC families in Maharashtra.
eligibility: Resident of Maharashtra belonging to Other Backward Class (OBC). Family annual income up to INR 1,20,000. Homeless or living in kutcha dwellings.
benefits: Financial assistance of INR 1,20,000 in rural areas and INR 1,50,000 in urban areas for pucca house construction.
required_documents: OBC Caste Certificate, Income Certificate from Tahsildar, Maharashtra Domicile, Plot ownership proof or Gram Panchayat certificate, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply on the dedicated MahaAwas state housing portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
target_beneficiaries: Micro and Small Business Owners, Shopkeepers, Artisans, Small Manufacturers
description: Universal micro-finance credit delivery scheme funding non-corporate, non-farm small and micro-enterprises with loans up to INR 20 lakh without requiring any collateral.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen engaged in or planning to start non-farm income-generating activity such as manufacturing, processing, trading, or service sector activity.
benefits: Categorized loan products: Shishu (loans up to INR 50,000), Kishore (loans from INR 50,001 to INR 5,00,000), and Tarun / Tarun Plus (loans up to INR 20,00,000). Zero collateral required and competitive interest rates.
required_documents: Business Plan / Proposal, Identity and Address Proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID), Proof of Business Address/Registration, Bank statements for last 6 months.
application_procedure: Apply on the JanSamarth or Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or walk into any commercial bank, RRB, or MFI branch.

name: PM Vishwakarma Kaushal Samman Scheme
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
target_beneficiaries: Traditional Artisans and Craftspeople in 18 Identified Trades (Carpenters, Blacksmiths, Potters, Cobblers, Tailors, etc.)
description: Comprehensive institutional support scheme for traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools, providing them with training, toolkit grants, and collateral-free loans.
eligibility: Artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools in one of 18 trades (Carpenter, Boat Maker, Armorer, Blacksmith, Hammer/Tool Kit Maker, Locksmith, Sculptor, Goldsmith, Potter, Cobbler, Mason, Basket/Mat/Broom Maker, Doll/Toy Maker, Barber, Garland Maker, Washerman, Tailor, Fishing Net Maker). Minimum age 18.
benefits: Recognition as PM Vishwakarma with ID card, basic and advanced skill training with INR 500/day stipend, modern toolkit incentive of INR 15,00, and collateral-free enterprise loans up to INR 3,00,000 at concessional 5% interest rate.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Mobile Number, Bank Passbook, Ration Card, Trade Verification from Gram Panchayat / Urban ULB.
application_procedure: Biometric registration at nearest CSC center on pmvishwakarma.gov.in followed by three-stage verification.

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
department: Ministry of MSME / SIDBI
target_beneficiaries: New and Existing Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs)
description: Providing collateral-free credit guarantee to Member Lending Institutions (MLIs) to facilitate credit flow to micro and small enterprises without third-party guarantee.
eligibility: New and existing Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) engaged in manufacturing or service activities holding valid Udyam Registration.
benefits: Credit facility up to INR 5 crore without any third-party collateral or mortgage, with CGTMSE providing credit guarantee coverage up to 85% of sanctioned loan.
required_documents: Udyam Registration Certificate, Audited Financial Statements, Project Feasibility Report, IT Returns.
application_procedure: Apply directly through partner commercial banks or NBFCs; bank invokes CGTMSE guarantee cover directly.

name: Maharashtra Package Scheme of Incentives (PSI for MSMEs)
department: Directorate of Industries, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Manufacturing MSMEs Setting Up in Developing Districts of Maharashtra
description: Attractive fiscal incentive package encouraging industrial dispersal to underdeveloped and developing regions (Vidarbha, Marathwada, North Maharashtra, Konkan) of Maharashtra.
eligibility: New micro, small, and medium manufacturing units set up in specified talukas (Taluka categories B, C, D, D+, and Vidarbha/Marathwada). Valid Udyam registration and commercial production certificate.
benefits: Industrial Promotion Subsidy (IPS) linked to Gross SGST paid, interest subsidy of 5% on term loans for up to 7 years, electricity duty exemption, and power tariff subsidy of INR 1-2 per unit.
required_documents: Udyam Certificate, Industrial Entrepreneur Memorandum (IEM), Land title / lease deed, Term loan sanction letter, Audited balance sheet, First electricity bill.
application_procedure: Apply online through the Maitri single-window portal (maitri.mahaonline.gov.in) under Package Scheme of Incentives.

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
department: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry
target_beneficiaries: DPIIT-Recognized Early-Stage Startups
description: Financial assistance to early-stage innovative startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market-entry, and commercialization.
eligibility: Startup recognized by DPIIT, incorporated not more than 2 years ago at the time of application, having business idea with market fit and viable commercialization strategy.
benefits: Up to INR 20 lakh as a grant for validation of proof of concept, or prototype development, and up to INR 50 lakh of investment for market entry and commercialization via convertible debentures/debt.
required_documents: DPIIT Recognition Certificate, Pitch Deck, Business Plan, Financial Projections, Incorporation Certificate.
application_procedure: Apply online through the Startup India Seed Fund portal (seedfund.startupindia.gov.in) selecting preference of approved incubators.

name: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana (Maharashtra)
department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Destitute Persons, Widows, Divyang Persons, Abandoned Women, and Transgender Persons
description: State social security monthly financial pension scheme for destitute persons who have no family support or source of livelihood in Maharashtra.
eligibility: Resident of Maharashtra for at least 15 years. Age below 65 (or destitute of any adult age). Annual family income must not exceed INR 21,000 per annum (increased in select categories to INR 50,000). Blind, disabled, suffering from major illness, or destitute women.
benefits: Monthly pension of INR 1,500 per month for a single destitute person, and INR 2,000 per month if there are two or more beneficiaries in the household.
required_documents: Maharashtra Domicile Certificate (15 years residency), Tahsildar Income Certificate, Age Proof, Medical Disability Certificate (if applicable), Death certificate of husband (for widows).
application_procedure: Submit physical or online application at the Tahsildar office / Sanjay Gandhi Yojana branch in the local taluka.

name: Shravanbal Seva Rajya Nivruttivetan Yojana (Maharashtra Senior Pension)
department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Destitute and Low-Income Senior Citizens Aged 65 and Above
description: Monthly pension scheme by the Maharashtra Government honoring elderly citizens belonging to below-poverty-line and destitute families.
eligibility: Resident of Maharashtra for minimum 15 years. Age 65 years or above. Annual family income not exceeding INR 21,000 (Category A: Not in BPL list; Category B: In Central BPL list).
benefits: Monthly pension of INR 1,500 per month deposited directly into the beneficiary elderly person's bank account via DBT.
required_documents: Age proof (School leaving certificate / Voter ID / Aadhaar), Domicile Certificate (15 years), Tahsildar Income Certificate, BPL Card (if Category B), Bank Passbook.
application_procedure: Apply at the local Tahsildar Office or through Aaple Sarkar portal under the Social Justice department.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
department: Department of Rural Development, Ministry of Rural Development
target_beneficiaries: Elderly Persons Living Below the Poverty Line (BPL)
description: National social assistance monthly pension provided to indigent elderly citizens living below the poverty line across all states and union territories.
eligibility: Person aged 60 years or higher. Must belong to a household living below the poverty line (BPL) verified through the SECC / state BPL list.
benefits: Central monthly pension supplemented by state government contribution (total combined payout ranges from INR 1,000 to INR 2,000 per month; higher for 80+ seniors).
required_documents: BPL Card, Age Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID), Bank Account details linked to DBT, Domicile proof.
application_procedure: Apply at local Gram Panchayat office in rural areas or Municipal Municipality office in urban areas.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) / Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: Unorganized Sector Workers and All Citizens Aged 18 to 40
description: Government-backed guaranteed minimum monthly pension scheme designed to provide social security in old age for workers in the unorganized sector.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen between 18 and 40 years of age having a savings bank account. Must not be an income tax payer.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of INR 1,000, INR 2,000, INR 3,000, INR 4,000, or INR 5,000 per month starting at age 60, with lifetime continuation to spouse and return of pension corpus to nominee.
required_documents: Savings Bank Account details, Aadhaar Card, Nominee Details.
application_procedure: Enroll via net banking or walk into any bank or post office branch and submit APY enrollment form.

name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (RVY)
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice
target_beneficiaries: BPL and Low-Income Senior Citizens Suffering from Age-Related Disabilities
description: Providing physical assisted-living devices and age-related disability aids to senior citizens belonging to BPL category or family income under INR 15,000/month.
eligibility: Senior citizen aged 60+ possessing BPL ration card or monthly income certificate below INR 15,000, experiencing age-related physical impairments (vision, hearing, teeth, walking).
benefits: Free distribution of customized assistive devices: walking sticks, elbow crutches, walkers, hearing aids, wheelchairs, spectacles, and artificial dentures.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, BPL Card or Income Certificate, Age Proof, Medical Assessment Certificate from government camp.
application_procedure: Assessment and distribution camps organized by ALIMCO in coordination with district administration.

name: ADIP Scheme (Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances)
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice
target_beneficiaries: Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) Holding UDID Card
description: Assisting needy disabled persons in procuring sophisticated, durable, and scientifically manufactured aids and appliances to enhance physical, economic, and social rehabilitation.
eligibility: Indian citizen with 40% or more certified disability. Monthly income from all sources not exceeding INR 20,000 (100% subsidy for income up to INR 15,000; 50% subsidy for income between INR 15,001 and INR 20,000).
benefits: Free or heavily subsidized motorized tricycles, smart canes, digital hearing aids, braille kits, prosthetic limbs, and battery-operated wheelchairs.
required_documents: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card / Disability Certificate, Income Certificate, Residence Proof, Aadhaar Card.
application_procedure: Apply through ALIMCO camps, District Disability Rehabilitation Centers (DDRC), or online via the ADIP web portal.

name: Maharashtra Divyang Swayamrojgar Yojana (Self-Employment Loan Subsidy)
department: Maharashtra State Divyang Finance and Development Corporation (MSDFDC)
target_beneficiaries: Differently-Abled Persons (Divyangjan) in Maharashtra
description: Concessional finance and capital subsidy for persons with disabilities in Maharashtra to start retail, transport, service, or manufacturing micro-businesses.
eligibility: Resident of Maharashtra aged 18 to 55 years having minimum 40% permanent disability certificate. Family annual income within prescribed limits.
benefits: Subsidized term loans up to INR 5,00,000 with interest subvention down to 4% p.a., along with 20% capital margin subsidy from the state government.
required_documents: Civil Surgeon Disability Certificate / UDID, Maharashtra Domicile, Tahsildar Income Certificate, Project Proposal, Aadhaar Card.
application_procedure: Submit application to the District Social Welfare Office / MSDFDC district manager.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (Rooftop Solar Subsidy)
department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), Government of India
target_beneficiaries: Residential Households Installing Rooftop Solar Plants
description: Revolutionary solar power scheme providing substantial financial subsidies to residential households to install rooftop solar units and get up to 300 units of free electricity every month.
eligibility: Residential households across India having a suitable roof, grid electricity connection in the applicant's name, and an eligible DISCOM consumer number. No income restriction.
benefits: Direct capital subsidy of INR 30,000 for 1 kW systems, INR 60,000 for 2 kW systems, and INR 78,000 for 3 kW and larger systems directly deposited into the consumer's bank account. Up to 300 units of free electricity per month.
required_documents: Electricity Bill consumer number, Aadhaar Card, Rooftop photographs, Bank Account linked to Aadhaar (for DBT subsidy disbursement).
application_procedure: Register and apply on the national portal pmsuryaghar.gov.in, choose registered DISCOM vendor, obtain technical feasibility approval, and submit commissioning report.

name: Aaple Sarkar - Maharashtra Right to Public Services Act (RTS)
department: General Administration Department (Information Technology), Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: All Citizens of Maharashtra Requiring Certified Public Documents
description: State digital service delivery portal guaranteeing time-bound, transparent, and hassle-free online issuance of 500+ government certificates, revenue records, and departmental permits.
eligibility: All citizens domiciled or residing in Maharashtra needing public certificates (Income Certificate, Domicile/Residence, Caste Certificate, Non-Creamy Layer, 7/12 Extract, Age/Nationality/Domicile).
benefits: Guaranteed legal delivery timeline (mostly 7 to 15 days). Certified digitally-signed documents delivered directly to the citizen's user dashboard without visiting government offices.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Proof of Address (Ration Card/Light Bill), Self-declaration affidavit, Passport photo, Supporting records based on specific certificate requested.
application_procedure: Register on the Aaple Sarkar portal (aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in), select department (Revenue/Home/Urban), submit application fee (INR 20-50), and track application status.

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY / Free Foodgrain Scheme)
department: Department of Food and Public Distribution, Ministry of Consumer Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Priority Households (PHH) and Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) Families
description: World's largest food security safety net providing free monthly foodgrains to over 81 crore poor and vulnerable citizens across India.
eligibility: Beneficiary families holding Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) or Priority Household (PHH) ration cards under the National Food Security Act (NFSA).
benefits: Free 5 kg foodgrains (rice/wheat/coarse grains) per person per month for Priority Households and 35 kg foodgrains per family per month for Antyodaya families without any cost.
required_documents: NFSA Ration Card, Aadhaar Card linked to Ration Card.
application_procedure: Collect monthly entitlement from nearest Fair Price Shop (Ration Shop) using biometric e-PoS authentication (One Nation One Ration Card applicable).

name: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Nal Se Jal)
department: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation, Ministry of Jal Shakti
target_beneficiaries: All Rural Households
description: Ensuring universal access to safe and adequate drinking water through individual Functional Household Tap Connections (FHTC) to all rural households.
eligibility: Rural households residing in any gram panchayat village across India.
benefits: Piped clean drinking water supplied at the rate of 55 liters per capita per day (lpcd) directly at household doorsteps.
required_documents: Village residence proof, Aadhaar Card.
application_procedure: Implemented by Village Water and Sanitation Committees (VWSC) and Gram Panchayats with community participation.

name: Bal Sangopan Yojana (Foster Care and Child Protection Maharashtra)
department: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Orphaned, Abandoned, and Vulnerable Children Living with Relative Guardians
description: Financial assistance program providing monthly maintenance support to families and foster guardians caring for orphaned, single-parent, or destitute children.
eligibility: Children under 18 years whose parents have passed away, single-parent destitute households, or parents suffering from terminal illness/imprisonment. Annual family income below INR 1,00,000.
benefits: Monthly financial grant of INR 2,250 per child (recently enhanced from INR 1,125) provided to the guardian to support education, nutrition, and welfare of the child.
required_documents: Child Birth Certificate, Parents' Death Certificate (or medical certificate), Guardian Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, School Bonafide Certificate.
application_procedure: Submit application to District Child Protection Unit (DCPU) or Women and Child Development Department at district headquarters.

name: National Overseas Scholarship for SC and Nomadic Students
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
target_beneficiaries: SC, DNT, and Landless Laborer Students Pursuing Masters/PhD Abroad
description: Financial grant for low-income Scheduled Caste students to pursue Master's degrees and PhD programs in top world universities.
eligibility: SC student with minimum 60% marks in qualifying degree. Total family income under INR 8,00,000. Admitted to top 500 QS ranking foreign universities.
benefits: Full tuition fees, annual maintenance allowance (approx. USD 15,400 or GBP 9,900), economy airfare, visa fees, and medical insurance.
required_documents: Foreign University Offer Letter, Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, Passport, Degree Marksheet.
application_procedure: Online application via nosmsje.gov.in portal.

name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship for Minority Girls
department: Maulana Azad Education Foundation, Ministry of Minority Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Minority Girl Students in Classes 9 to 12
description: Scholarship to support minority girl students belonging to Muslim, Christian, Jain, Buddhist, Sikh, and Parsi communities.
eligibility: Girl students studying in Class 9th, 10th, 11th, or 12th with minimum 50% aggregate. Family income below INR 2,00,000.
benefits: INR 5,000 for Class 9 and 10; INR 6,00,000 for Class 11 and 12 credited via DBT.
required_documents: Minority Community Certificate, Marksheet, School Verification, Income Certificate, Bank Passbook.
application_procedure: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: Rajarshi Shahu Maharaj Gunvatta Puraskar (Merit Award for SC Students)
department: Social Justice Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Meritorious SC Students Passing 10th and 12th Board Exams
description: Merit award encouraging SC students who achieve distinction in Maharashtra State Secondary and Higher Secondary Board exams.
eligibility: SC student scoring 75% or above in SSC or HSC exams in Maharashtra board.
benefits: Special cash award of INR 3,000 to INR 6,000 with merit certificate.
required_documents: 10th/12th Board Marksheet, Caste Certificate, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Disbursed through district social welfare officer via MahaDBT.

name: Pradhan Mantri Vidya Lakshmi Education Loan Portal
department: Department of Higher Education / NSDL
target_beneficiaries: Students Seeking Higher Education Bank Loans and Subsidies
description: Single-window electronic platform for students seeking education loans and government interest subvention schemes (CSIS) across 40+ banks.
eligibility: Students enrolled in approved higher technical/professional courses in India or abroad.
benefits: Easy loan access up to INR 20 lakh with 100% full interest subsidy during moratorium period for students with family income under INR 4.5 lakh.
required_documents: Admission letter, fee structure, 10th/12th/Degree marksheet, Income Certificate, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Register and fill Common Educational Loan Application Form (CELAF) on vidyalakshmi.co.in.

name: Kishore Vaigyanik Protsahan Yojana (KVPY / INSPIRE Fellowship)
department: Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India
target_beneficiaries: Students Pursuing Pure Sciences and Research (B.Sc, M.Sc, BS-MS)
description: Encouraging talented students to take up research careers in Basic and Natural Sciences through prestigious national fellowships.
eligibility: Top 1% ranking in 12th board exams or top rankers in JEE/NEET enrolled in natural and basic sciences courses.
benefits: Scholarship of INR 80,000 annually (INR 5,000 monthly stipend plus INR 20,000 mentorship contingency grant).
required_documents: Board top 1% certificate, College Bonafide, Identity Proof, Bank Details.
application_procedure: Apply online at online-inspire.gov.in.

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY Organic Farming Subsidy)
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Farmers Forming Organic Farming Clusters
description: Promoting commercial organic farming through cluster approach and Participatory Guarantee System (PGS) certification.
eligibility: Groups of 20 or more farmers forming 50-acre clusters adopting natural/organic agricultural practices.
benefits: Financial assistance of INR 50,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic inputs, vermicompost, bio-fertilizers, packaging, and branding.
required_documents: 7/12 Land Extract, Group registration, Aadhaar cards of members.
application_procedure: Apply via District Agriculture Office or Jaivik Kheti portal (jaivikkheti.in).

name: National Beekeeping and Honey Mission (NBHM)
department: National Bee Board (NBB), Ministry of Agriculture
target_beneficiaries: Farmers, Beekeepers, and Rural Youth
description: Promoting holistic beekeeping for pollination service, honey production, and secondary income generation.
eligibility: Farmers and trained individuals undertaking apiculture with bee colonies.
benefits: Subsidy up to 75% for purchase of 50 to 500 bee boxes and colonies, plus honey processing and extraction equipment grants.
required_documents: Land proof or lease, Training certificate, Aadhaar, Bank Details.
application_procedure: Register on the Madhukranti portal (madhukranti.moa.gov.in).

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY - Fisheries)
department: Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
target_beneficiaries: Fishers, Fish Farmers, Self-Help Groups, and Aqua Entrepreneurs
description: Comprehensive development of inland and marine aquaculture, fish ponds, biofloc systems, and cold-chain transport.
eligibility: Traditional fishermen, inland aquaculture pond owners, fish farmers, and marine coastal boat operators.
benefits: 40% financial subsidy for general category and 60% for women, SC, and ST beneficiaries for new pond construction, biofloc units, and motor boats.
required_documents: Land record or pond lease deed, Aadhaar Card, Fisheries Society recommendation.
application_procedure: Apply via pmmsy.dof.gov.in or District Fisheries Development Officer.

name: National Livestock Mission (NLM - Poultry, Goat and Sheep Farming)
department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Government of India
target_beneficiaries: Farmers and Entrepreneurs Setting up Goat, Sheep, and Poultry Breeding Units
description: Entrepreneurship development in livestock sector focusing on sheep, goat, piggery, and poultry breed improvement.
eligibility: Individual farmers, FPOs, and entrepreneurs with land ownership/lease and bank loan sanction for livestock farm.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy (up to INR 50 lakh for 500-goat units and INR 25 lakh for poultry parent farm) deposited directly into bank subsidy reserve.
required_documents: Detailed Project Report, Bank sanction letter, Land title / lease deed, Aadhaar, Training certificate.
application_procedure: Apply online through the NLM portal (nlm.udyamimitra.in).

name: Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana (Tribal Farmer Irrigation Assistance)
department: Tribal Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Scheduled Tribe (ST) Farmers in Maharashtra
description: Irrigation infrastructure financial support for tribal farmers in Maharashtra to increase agricultural yield.
eligibility: Scheduled Tribe farmer residing in Maharashtra with cultivable land between 0.40 and 6 hectares. Family income up to INR 1.5 lakh.
benefits: Grant up to INR 2,50,000 for digging a new well, INR 50,000 for borewell repairs, and INR 25,000 for motor pump sets.
required_documents: Tribe Certificate, 7/12 Land Extract, Income Certificate, Bank Passbook, Groundwater survey report.
application_procedure: Apply on the MahaDBT Farmer Portal under Tribal Agriculture schemes.

name: Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme (PMNDP)
department: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: End-Stage Renal Disease Patients (Kidney Failure)
description: Providing free dialysis services to poor and vulnerable patients at district hospitals across India.
eligibility: Patients diagnosed with chronic kidney failure requiring hemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis.
benefits: 100% free hemodialysis sessions in public-private partnership (PPP) centers located at district government civil hospitals.
required_documents: Ration Card (BPL/Priority), Nephrologist Prescription, Aadhaar Card.
application_procedure: Register at the dialysis unit of the district civil hospital or through the PMNDP portal.

name: National Mental Health Helpline (Tele-MANAS)
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / NIMHANS
target_beneficiaries: Citizens Experiencing Stress, Anxiety, Depression, and Mental Health Challenges
description: 24x7 toll-free tele-mental health counseling and psychiatric support network available across India in multiple regional languages.
eligibility: Open to any citizen across India seeking emotional support, counseling, or psychiatric guidance.
benefits: Immediate, free, confidential tele-consultations with trained clinical psychologists, counselors, and psychiatrists. Referral to district mental health units.
required_documents: None required.
application_procedure: Dial toll-free national helpline 14416 or 1800-891-4416 from any phone.

name: Universal Health Coverage Scheme for Divyangjan (Swavlamban Health Insurance)
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities / New India Assurance
target_beneficiaries: Persons with Disabilities with Blindness, Locomotor, Hearing, or Autism Impairments
description: Affordable group health insurance scheme designed specifically for persons with disabilities not covered under general commercial health policies.
eligibility: Person with disability holding valid disability certificate with family income under INR 3,00,000.
benefits: Health insurance cover up to INR 2,00,000 per annum covering OPD, surgeries, corrective corrective aids, and OPD therapy sessions.
required_documents: Disability Certificate / UDID, Income Proof, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Enroll via empanelled NGO or National Trust portal.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
