target_beneficiaries: Poor Pregnant Women Delivering in Government Hospitals
description: Safe motherhood intervention scheme promoting institutional deliveries among poor pregnant women to reduce neonatal and maternal mortality.
eligibility: All pregnant women from BPL / SC / ST categories delivering in government public health facilities or accredited private hospitals.
benefits: Cash incentive of INR 1,400 for rural areas and INR 1,000 for urban areas paid directly to mother at time of discharge, plus transport assistance.
required_documents: MCP Card, Aadhaar, Bank Details, Hospital Discharge Slip.
application_procedure: Registered during pregnancy checkup at primary health center / sub-center.

name: Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK - Child Health Screening)
department: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Children Aged 0 to 18 Years in Anganwadis and Government Schools
description: Early identification and free intervention for 4Ds: Defects at birth, Deficiencies, Diseases, and Development delays including disabilities.
eligibility: All children enrolled in Anganwadi centers and government/aided schools from preschool to class 12.
benefits: Free mobile health team screening and 100% free medical treatment/surgical correction (congenital heart disease, cleft lip/palate, club foot) at District Early Intervention Centers (DEIC).
required_documents: School/Anganwadi ID, Aadhaar Card, RBSK Screening Card.
application_procedure: Mobile health teams conduct screening at schools twice a year; identified cases referred to civil hospitals.

name: Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Pariyojana (MKSP)
department: Ministry of Rural Development / Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NRLM
target_beneficiaries: Small and Marginal Women Farmers in Rural SHGs
description: Empowering women farmers by making systematic investments to enhance their participation and productivity in sustainable agriculture.
eligibility: Women farmers belonging to rural Self Help Groups (SHGs).
benefits: Subsidies for seed banks, bio-inputs, farm machinery banks managed by women, and intensive training in agro-ecology.
required_documents: SHG Membership proof, Aadhaar, Land / Cultivation proof.
application_procedure: Implemented through State Rural Livelihoods Mission (MSRLM - Umed in Maharashtra).

name: Mission Shakti - Sambal (One Stop Centre / Sakhi)
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_beneficiaries: Women Affected by Domestic Violence, Harassment, or Abuse
description: Integrated 24x7 crisis support facility offering police assistance, medical treatment, legal counsel, and psychological shelter under one roof.
eligibility: Any woman or girl facing violence or harassment in public or private spaces.
benefits: Free temporary shelter (up to 5 days), free legal aid, medical examination, counseling, and direct police protection.
required_documents: None needed for emergency admission.
application_procedure: Walk into any Sakhi One Stop Centre at district hospital campus or call Women Helpline 181.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala / Kanya Daan Yojana
department: Women and Child Development Department
target_beneficiaries: Parents of Underprivileged Girl Children
description: Financial support to vulnerable parents for girl child education and mass marriage assistance.
eligibility: BPL and low-income families whose daughters are enrolled in schools or marrying in community mass marriage events.
benefits: Financial assistance of INR 20,000 to INR 50,000 provided in stages for education milestones or marriage gifts.
required_documents: Birth Certificate, Ration Card, Income Certificate, School Bonafide / Marriage registration.
application_procedure: Submit application to District Women and Child Officer.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
department: Ministry of Rural Development
target_beneficiaries: Poor Rural Youth Aged 15 to 35 Years
description: Demand-driven placement-linked skill training program exclusively for rural youth from poor households.
eligibility: Rural youth aged 15-35 years (up to 45 for women and PwDs) belonging to BPL or MGNREGA worker families.
benefits: 100% free residential training with boarding, lodging, uniform, tablet/books, and mandatory minimum 70% guaranteed job placement with market wages.
required_documents: BPL Card or MGNREGA Job Card, 10th/12th Marksheet, Aadhaar Card, Passport Photos.
application_procedure: Register via Kaushal Panjee app or attend rural mobilization camps conducted by project implementation agencies (PIA).

name: National Career Service (NCS Portal)
department: Ministry of Labour and Employment
target_beneficiaries: Job Seekers, Fresh Graduates, and Employers
description: Free nationwide digital platform connecting job seekers with verified employers, government job openings, career counselors, and job fairs.
eligibility: All citizens seeking employment, internships, apprenticeships, or career guidance.
benefits: Direct access to over 10 lakh verified private and government job vacancies, free skill assessments, career counseling, and online job fairs.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Educational Details, Resume.
application_procedure: Create free profile on ncs.gov.in and apply directly for jobs.

name: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries (SFURTI)
department: Ministry of MSME
target_beneficiaries: Traditional Artisans, Khadi Workers, Bamboo and Honey Clusters
description: Organizing traditional artisans and craftspeople into sustainable clusters to equip them with common facility centers (CFC), advanced machinery, and design branding.
eligibility: Artisan clusters comprising minimum 500 artisans promoted by NGOs, cooperatives, or producer companies.
benefits: Financial grant up to INR 2.5 crore for Regular Clusters (up to 500 artisans) and up to INR 5 crore for Major Clusters (more than 500 artisans) covering 90% of plant and machinery costs.
required_documents: Cluster DPR, Producer Company registration, Member Artisan database.
application_procedure: Proposals submitted via SFURTI portal (sfurti.msme.gov.in).

name: ASPIRE Scheme for Rural Livelihoods and Agro-Industry Incubation
department: Ministry of MSME
target_beneficiaries: Agro-Rural Innovators, Incubators, and Rural Startups
description: Promoting innovation, rural entrepreneurship, and agro-industry by setting up Livelihood Business Incubators (LBIs) and Technology Business Incubators (TBIs).
eligibility: Institutions, universities, and polytechnics setting up incubators in agro-rural processing and technology.
benefits: One-time financial grant up to INR 1 crore for machinery and equipment to set up Livelihood Business Incubators.
required_documents: Institutional profile, incubation DPR, Land and building clearance.
application_procedure: Online submission on the ASPIRE portal under Ministry of MSME.

name: SVAMITVA Scheme (Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology)
department: Ministry of Panchayati Raj
target_beneficiaries: Rural Property Owners in Abadi (Inhabited) Areas
description: Providing legal ownership rights (Property Cards / Sanad) to rural house owners in inhabited village areas using high-precision drone surveying.
eligibility: Rural residents owning houses in gaothan / abadi areas of villages covered under the survey.
benefits: Official digital Property Card (Sanad) enabling rural owners to use their residential homes as financial assets to take bank loans and resolve land disputes.
required_documents: Village residence proof, Aadhaar Card, Physical demarcation of boundaries during drone survey.
application_procedure: Drone survey conducted by Survey of India and Gram Panchayat; property cards generated on state revenue portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)
department: Ministry of Rural Development
target_beneficiaries: Rural Habitations Seeking All-Weather Road Connectivity
description: Providing all-weather motorable pucca road connectivity to unconnected rural habitations across India.
eligibility: Unconnected habitations with population 500+ in plain areas and 250+ in hill and tribal districts.
benefits: Construction of high-quality asphalted all-weather roads and bridges connecting villages to market centers, schools, and hospitals.
required_documents: Habitation details from Gram Panchayat road resolution.
application_procedure: Proposals formulated by District Rural Development Agency (DRDA) and approved by state rural roads body.

name: Mahavitaran Krishi Pump Electricity Bill Waiver Scheme (Mukhyamantri Baliraja Vevasay)
department: Energy Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Agricultural Water Pump Consumers up to 7.5 HP in Maharashtra
description: 100% electricity bill waiver and free electricity for agricultural water pumps up to 7.5 HP capacity for 44 lakh farmers across Maharashtra.
eligibility: Farmers in Maharashtra having registered agricultural water pump electricity connections with MSEDCL (Mahavitaran) up to 7.5 Horsepower.
benefits: Zero electricity bill; state government pays 100% of the agricultural pump electricity charges directly to Mahavitaran on behalf of farmers.
required_documents: MSEDCL Agricultural Consumer Number, 7/12 Extract.
application_procedure: Automated billing adjustment in regular Mahavitaran electricity bills; consumers can verify status on mahadiscom.in.

name: Digital India Bhashini (AI Multilingual Language Services)
department: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
target_beneficiaries: Citizens Accessing Public Digital Services in Regional Languages
description: National AI language translation mission breaking language barriers by enabling voice-to-text, text-to-voice, and document translation across 22 scheduled Indian languages (including Marathi and Hindi).
eligibility: All citizens using digital government portals and public mobile applications.
benefits: Enables voice-based scheme discovery, real-time regional language translation of official notifications, and speech-enabled public portals.
required_documents: None.
application_procedure: Integrated natively within government portals or available via Bhashini App.

name: DigiLocker (National Digital Document Wallet)
department: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
target_beneficiaries: All Indian Citizens with Aadhaar
description: Secure cloud-based digital platform for issuance, storage, and sharing of legally valid electronic documents and certificates directly from official issuing authorities.
eligibility: Any Indian resident possessing an Aadhaar-linked mobile number.
benefits: Legally valid electronic access (under IT Act 2000 Rule 9A) to over 3,000 document types: Driving License, Vehicle RC, Class 10/12 Marksheets, Ration Card, Caste Certificate, Domicile, and PAN Card.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Mobile Number linked to Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Sign up on digilocker.gov.in or DigiLocker mobile app and pull documents from respective departments.

name: Vidyasaarathi Scholarship Portal Initiative
department: NSDL e-Governance / Corporate CSR
target_beneficiaries: Undergraduate, ITI, and Diploma Students from Lower Income Groups
description: Single-window scholarship application platform bridging students with diverse corporate CSR educational scholarships for technical and degree studies.
eligibility: Students enrolled in recognized ITI, Diploma, or Degree courses with minimum 50% marks and family income under INR 5,00,000.
benefits: Scholarships ranging from INR 10,000 to INR 75,000 per academic year disbursed directly into student bank accounts.
required_documents: College ID, Fee Receipt, Previous Marksheet, Income Certificate, Bank Details.
application_procedure: Register and match profiles on vidyasaarathi.co.in.

name: Sant Dnyaneshwar Shikshan Shulkh Pratipurtie Yojana
department: Social Justice Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Children of Sugarcane Workers (Uss-Tod Kamgar) in Maharashtra
description: Full educational fee reimbursement and hostel lodging support for children of seasonal sugarcane cutters in Maharashtra.
eligibility: Child of registered sugarcane harvesting worker certified by village sugar factory or Tahsildar. Enrolled in higher secondary or degree course.
benefits: 100% college tuition fees paid, free hostel facility, and monthly food allowance.
required_documents: Sugarcane Worker Registration Card, Domicile Certificate, Marksheet, College Admission Proof.
application_procedure: Apply on the MahaDBT portal under the Sugarcane Workers Welfare Corporation tab.

name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP)
department: Ministry of Education
target_beneficiaries: Meritorious College Students from Weaker Sections
description: Comprehensive umbrella scheme combining Central Sector scholarships, college interest subsidies, and special scholarships for university students.
eligibility: Students enrolled in regular undergraduate and postgraduate courses having family income below INR 4.5 lakh.
benefits: Direct annual scholarship of INR 12,000 to INR 20,000 per year credited via DBT.
required_documents: 12th Marksheet, Income Certificate, College Bonafide, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS) Free Education
department: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Scheduled Tribe (ST) Children in Remote Areas
description: Quality CBSE middle and high school residential education for tribal students to enable them to access higher education and sports.
eligibility: ST boys and girls passing entrance test for Class 6 admission in notified tribal blocks.
benefits: 100% free residential education, boarding, lodging, uniforms, books, computers, and medical care up to Class 12.
required_documents: Tribe Certificate, School Transfer Certificate, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Selection through State EMRS Entrance Examination.

name: Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth Farmer Child Higher Education Concession
department: Agriculture Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Children of Farmers Enrolled in Agriculture Degrees (B.Sc Agri, B.Tech Food)
description: Tuition fee concessions and reserved agricultural quotas for children of landholding farmers admitted to state agricultural universities.
eligibility: Parent must own agricultural land in Maharashtra as per 7/12 extract. Student admitted via MCAER entrance counseling.
benefits: Fee concession up to 50% and 12 bonus points in MCAER state agriculture university admission ranking.
required_documents: 7/12 Land Extract, Bonafide Farmer Certificate from Tahsildar, CET/MCAER Scorecard.
application_procedure: Submit farmer quota certificate during MCAER online counseling.

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Farmers Installing Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation Systems
description: Enhancing farm water productivity through precision micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler) with substantial capital grants.
eligibility: Landholding farmers cultivating horticulture or field crops with water source.
benefits: Subsidy of 55% for small/marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers on purchase of certified drip and sprinkler irrigation equipment.
required_documents: 7/12 Land Record, 8A Extract, Micro-irrigation equipment bill/quotation, Aadhaar, Bank Details.
application_procedure: Apply on the MahaDBT Farmer Portal under the Micro Irrigation scheme tab.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF - Low Interest Warehousing Loans)
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Farmers, FPOs, Agri-Entrepreneurs, and Cooperatives
description: Medium-to-long term debt financing facility for post-harvest management infrastructure such as cold storages, warehouses, sorting/grading units, and silos.
eligibility: Farmers, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), primary agricultural credit societies (PACS), and startups.
benefits: Interest subvention of 3% per annum for loans up to INR 2 crore for up to 7 years, along with CGTMSE credit guarantee fee coverage.
required_documents: DPR for cold storage/warehouse, Land ownership/lease deed, KYC documents, Bank Loan proposal.
application_procedure: Submit project proposal on the AIF online portal (agriinfra.dac.gov.in).

name: Bhausaheb Fundkar Phalbag Lagwad Yojana (Horticulture Plantation Subsidy)
department: Agriculture Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Farmers Planting Fruit Orchards (Mango, Pomegranate, Guava, Orange, Custard Apple)
description: 100% financial subsidy program for planting perennial fruit orchards to boost horticulture production and farmer prosperity in Maharashtra.
eligibility: Farmers owning agricultural land in Maharashtra with assured irrigation source. Minimum 0.20 hectare to maximum 6 hectares per farmer.
benefits: 100% government financial subsidy covering sapling purchase, digging pits, manure, and maintenance costs spread over 3 years.
required_documents: 7/12 and 8A Land extracts, Soil and Water testing report, Aadhaar, Bank Passbook.
application_procedure: Apply through the MahaDBT Farmer Portal under the Horticulture Schemes category.

name: Seed Village Programme (Beej Gram Yojana)
department: Ministry of Agriculture / Mahabeej
target_beneficiaries: Farmers Groups Producing Certified Quality Seeds
description: Upgrading the quality of farmer-saved seeds by training farmers in seed production and providing subsidized foundation/certified seeds.
eligibility: Farmer groups cultivating recognized field crops in village clusters.
benefits: 50% to 60% price subsidy on foundation seed distribution and free training in seed grading, seed treatment, and storage.
required_documents: 7/12 Extract, Gram Panchayat cluster certification, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply through Taluka Agriculture Officer or Mahabeej local centers.

name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
department: Department of Agriculture / State Horticulture Mission Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Horticulture Growers, Greenhouse and Polyhouse Operators
description: Comprehensive development of horticulture sector covering fruits, vegetables, root crops, spices, and floriculture.
eligibility: Landholding farmers setting up protective cultivation structures or nurseries.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy on polyhouse, shade-net house construction, plastic mulching, and vegetable pack houses.
required_documents: 7/12 Extract, Polyhouse Engineering Estimate, Quotation from empanelled vendor, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply online on the MahaDBT Horticulture portal.

name: Balasaheb Thackeray Accident Insurance Scheme (Golden Hour Highway Trauma Aid)
department: Public Health Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Any Person Injured in Road Accidents on Maharashtra Highways
description: Immediate cashless emergency trauma stabilization treatment for highway accident victims during the critical first 'golden hour'.
eligibility: Any individual involved in a road vehicular accident within the geographical jurisdiction of Maharashtra state, irrespective of domicile or nationality.
benefits: 100% cashless emergency medical stabilization, intensive care, and surgeries up to INR 30,000 across 74 empanelled trauma care hospitals.
required_documents: Police accident memo or hospital emergency admission registration.
application_procedure: Hospital automatically activates scheme upon emergency admission of accident victim.

name: Pradhan Mantri TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan (Ni-kshay Mitra Community Nutrition)
department: Central TB Division, MoHFW
target_beneficiaries: Tuberculosis Patients Receiving Active Treatment
description: Community support initiative pairing diagnosed TB patients with voluntary individual/corporate donors (Ni-kshay Mitras) for food baskets.
eligibility: Consenting TB patients registered on the national Ni-kshay digital portal.
benefits: Monthly food baskets containing cereals, pulses, milk powder, cooking oil, and eggs provided directly to patients free of cost.
required_documents: Ni-kshay ID, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Enrolled through district tuberculosis officer or local DOTS provider.

name: eSanjeevani (National Telemedicine Consultation Service)
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: All Citizens Seeking Free Online Doctor Consultations from Home
description: World's largest digital telemedicine service connecting patients directly with certified government doctors and medical specialists via video call.
eligibility: Available to all citizens across India using smartphone or computer.
benefits: Free video consultation with MBBS doctors and super-specialists, digital prescriptions, and medicine advice without travel or hospital queues.
required_documents: Mobile number for OTP registration.
application_procedure: Download eSanjeevani app or visit esanjeevani.mohfw.gov.in and click 'Patient Consultation'.

name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABHA Card / Health ID)
department: National Health Authority (NHA)
target_beneficiaries: All Indian Citizens Creating Personal Digital Health Record
description: Creation of unique 14-digit Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) number allowing seamless digital linking and sharing of medical records.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen.
benefits: Lifelong secure digital health locker for storing lab reports, prescriptions, hospital discharge summaries, accessible with consent across all hospitals in India.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card and Mobile Number.
application_procedure: Generate free ABHA number online on abha.abdm.gov.in in less than 2 minutes.

name: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Clinic (Iron and Calcium Supplementation)
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Anemic Pregnant Women and Adolescent Girls
description: Nationwide anemia reduction program distributing therapeutic iron-folic acid and calcium supplements.
eligibility: Adolescent girls in schools and pregnant/lactating women in Anganwadis.
benefits: Free testing of hemoglobin levels and free supply of IFA tablets, syrup, and deworming Albendazole tablets.
required_documents: MCP Card or School ID.
application_procedure: Available at all Anganwadis, government schools, and PHCs.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mahila Shakti Kendra Scheme (MSK)
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_beneficiaries: Rural Women Seeking Skill Development, Literacy, and Digital Access
description: Empowering rural women through community participation, literacy camps, health awareness, and digital literacy hubs at block level.
eligibility: Rural women in designated aspirational and backward districts.
benefits: Free training in digital banking, smartphone usage, government scheme navigation, and nutrition guidance.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card.
application_procedure: Participate at Block Level Mahila Shakti Kendra or local Anganwadi hub.

name: Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya (KGBV Residential Schools)
department: Department of School Education and Literacy
target_beneficiaries: Disadvantaged Girls from SC, ST, OBC, and Minority Communities
description: Setting up residential upper-primary and secondary schools for girls belonging predominantly to SC, ST, OBC, and minority communities.
eligibility: Girl students from disadvantaged and BPL families who are dropouts or out-of-school in educationally backward blocks.
benefits: 100% free residential education, textbooks, stationery, food, boarding, uniforms, and computer training from Class 6 to Class 12.
required_documents: Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, Previous school TC if available, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply to local KGBV school or Block Education Officer (BEO).

name: Support to Training and Employment Programme for Women (STEP)
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_beneficiaries: Marginalized Women Aged 16 and Above Seeking Livelihood Skills
description: Providing employability skills and competencies to women in agriculture, horticulture, food processing, handlooms, and IT services.
eligibility: Women aged 16 years and above with priority to rural artisans and single women.
benefits: Free skill certification courses with stipend and micro-financing linkage for independent trade ventures.
required_documents: Identity Proof, Age Proof, Education Certificate (if any).
application_procedure: Enrolled through empanelled training institutions and state social welfare boards.

name: Working Women Hostel Scheme (Sakhi Niwas)
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_beneficiaries: Single Working Women in Urban Centers (Mumbai, Pune, Nagpur, etc.)
description: Safe, affordable, and clean residential hostel accommodation with day-care facility for children of working women away from hometown.
eligibility: Employed women whose gross monthly salary does not exceed INR 50,000 (metro) or INR 35,000 (other cities). Single, widowed, or separated women.
benefits: Subsidized secure accommodation, CCTV security, 24/7 warden, mess facilities, and on-site crèche for toddlers.
required_documents: Employment Letter, Salary Slip, Identity Proof, Permanent Residence Proof.
application_procedure: Apply to the superintendent of the local Sakhi Niwas / Working Women Hostel.

name: PM Internship Scheme in Top 500 Companies
department: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), Government of India
target_beneficiaries: Youth Aged 21 to 24 with High School, ITI, Diploma, or Degree
description: Providing 1.25 crore young people with real-world 12-month internship opportunities in India's top 500 commercial corporations.
eligibility: Indian youth aged 21 to 24 years not engaged in full-time employment. Family income under INR 8,00,000. Qualifications: 10th, 12th, ITI, Polytechnic, BA, B.Sc, B.Com, B.E., B.Tech.
benefits: Monthly stipend of INR 5,000 (INR 4,500 from Central Government via DBT + INR 500 from corporate CSR) plus one-time grant of INR 6,000 for incidentals.
required_documents: Educational Certificates, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account linked to DBT, Resume.
application_procedure: Apply on the national PM Internship portal (pminternship.mca.gov.in).

name: Mission Karmayogi (National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building)
department: Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT)
target_beneficiaries: Government Employees and Public Service Trainees
description: Comprehensive competency enhancement platform providing continuous digital learning for modern, citizen-centric public service delivery.
eligibility: Central and State government employees and officials across departments.
benefits: Free access to thousands of curated digital governance, technology, and management courses on iGOT Karmayogi platform.
required_documents: Government Employee ID, Official Email ID.
application_procedure: Log in to igotkarmayogi.gov.in using official government credentials.

name: PM Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises (PMFME)
department: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI)
target_beneficiaries: Micro Food Processing Units, Pickle/Spice Makers, Bakery Owners, SHGs
description: Credit-linked financial capital subsidy for upgrading informal micro food processing units under the 'One District One Product' (ODOP) initiative.
eligibility: Existing or new micro food processing enterprises, SHGs, and cooperatives. Must produce food products aligned with district ODOP or general food items.
benefits: Credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of eligible project cost with maximum ceiling of INR 10,00,000 per unit, plus seed capital of INR 40,000 per SHG member.
required_documents: Udyam Registration, Food safety FSSAI license, DPR, Bank loan sanction, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply online at pmfme.mofpi.gov.in or through District Resource Persons (DRP).

name: Design Clinic Scheme for MSMEs
department: Ministry of MSME
target_beneficiaries: Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises Improving Product Design
description: Encouraging MSMEs to adopt professional industrial design and packaging to make products globally competitive.
eligibility: Registered MSME manufacturing units with valid Udyam registration.
benefits: Financial assistance of 60% up to INR 40 lakh for student design projects and expert design consultation seminars.
required_documents: Udyam Certificate, Design project proposal, Audited Balance Sheet.
application_procedure: Submit proposal through design.msme.gov.in.

name: Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Reimbursement Scheme for Startups and MSMEs
department: Ministry of MSME / DPIIT
target_beneficiaries: Startups and MSMEs Filing Patents, Trademarks, and Geographical Indications
description: Reimbursing patent and trademark filing fees to foster innovation and protect proprietary technologies of young entrepreneurs.
eligibility: Registered MSME or DPIIT-recognized startup having filed or granted patents or registered trademarks in India or abroad.
benefits: Reimbursement of up to INR 1,00,000 for domestic patent grant, up to INR 5,00,000 for international patent grant, and up to INR 10,000 for trademark registration.
required_documents: Patent / Trademark grant certificate, Fee receipts from Patent Office, Udyam / DPIIT Certificate, Bank Details.
application_procedure: Apply on the MSME Champions portal (champions.gov.in).

name: National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS)
department: Ministry of Rural Development / Social Justice Department
target_beneficiaries: BPL Families on Death of Primary Breadwinner
description: Lump sum ex-gratia financial assistance to below-poverty-line families upon the demise of the primary earning member of the family.
eligibility: BPL household whose primary breadwinner (male or female) aged between 18 and 59 years has passed away.
benefits: One-time lump sum grant of INR 20,000 deposited directly into the bank account of the surviving spouse or eldest family member.
required_documents: Death Certificate of breadwinner, BPL Card, Age proof of deceased, Income Certificate, Bank Passbook.
application_procedure: Submit claim to Tahsildar Office or Block Development Officer within 6 months of death.

name: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS)
department: Ministry of Finance / Department of Economic Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Citizens Aged 60 Years and Above (or Retired Persons 55+)
description: Sovereign guaranteed quarterly interest-paying fixed savings scheme for senior citizens ensuring safe income and capital preservation.
eligibility: Individual aged 60+ or retired employees aged 55-60 electing retirement benefits within 1 month.
benefits: Highest sovereign small savings interest rate (8.2% per annum, paid quarterly) for a tenure of 5 years (extendable by 3 years). Deposit limit up to INR 30 lakh with Section 80C tax deduction.
required_documents: Age Proof (Aadhaar/PAN/Passport), Retirement Order (if 55-60), Bank Account Details.
application_procedure: Open account at any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch.

name: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY - LIC Pension for Seniors)
department: Department of Financial Services / Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)
target_beneficiaries: Senior Citizens Aged 60 and Above Seeking Guaranteed Regular Monthly Income
description: Government-subsidized pension scheme managed by LIC guaranteeing regular monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or annual income to elderly citizens.
eligibility: Any citizen aged 60 years or above with no upper age limit.
benefits: Assured regular pension payout yielding 7.4% to 7.6% per annum for a 10-year term, with purchase price refund to nominee upon demise.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Age Proof, Bank Account Details.
application_procedure: Available through LIC branch offices or online at licindia.in.

name: National Fellowship for Persons with Disabilities (NFPwD)
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities / UGC
target_beneficiaries: Students with Disabilities Pursuing M.Phil and Ph.D.
description: Prestigious research fellowship providing financial grants to students with disabilities to pursue advanced research degrees.
eligibility: Candidate with minimum 40% certified disability enrolled in regular full-time M.Phil/Ph.D. in recognized university.
benefits: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) of INR 37,000/month for first 2 years, Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) of INR 42,000/month for remaining 3 years, plus contingency and escort allowances.
required_documents: Disability Certificate / UDID, Postgraduate Marksheet, University Admission/Registration Letter, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply on the UGC fellowship portal (ugcnetonline.in / depwd.gov.in).

name: Deendayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme (DDRS)
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
target_beneficiaries: Voluntary Organizations Providing Special Schools and Vocational Training for PwDs
description: Grant-in-aid to NGOs running special schools for children with intellectual disabilities, hearing and visual impairments, and early intervention centers.
eligibility: Voluntary non-profit registered organizations active in disability rehabilitation.
benefits: Up to 90% funding for teacher salaries, equipment, boarding, lodging, and therapy in special schools.
required_documents: NGO Darpan ID, Audit Reports, PwD Enrollment Register.
application_procedure: Apply through ngogrants.depwd.gov.in.

name: Accessible India Campaign (Sugamya Bharat Abhiyan)
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
target_beneficiaries: Persons with Disabilities and Mobility Impairments
description: Nationwide flagship campaign to achieve universal accessibility in the built environment, transportation, and information and communication ecosystem.
eligibility: Universal benefit for all citizens with mobility and sensory disabilities.
benefits: Construction of wheelchair ramps, tactile paths, accessible toilets, lifts with braille buttons in public buildings, railway stations, airports, and government websites.
required_documents: None.
application_procedure: Citizens can report inaccessible infrastructure using the Sugamya Bharat App for remediation.

name: Maharashtra Student Bus Concession Scheme (ST Mahamandal Pass)
department: Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation (MSRTC)
target_beneficiaries: School and College Students in Maharashtra
description: Concessional and free state transport bus passes for rural and urban students commuting to schools, junior colleges, and ITIs.
eligibility: Student studying up to Class 12 in recognized schools or degree colleges in Maharashtra.
benefits: 100% free bus travel for girls up to Class 12; 66% concession on monthly bus fare for boys.
required_documents: School/College Bonafide Certificate, Aadhaar, Passport photos.
application_procedure: Apply at nearest MSRTC Bus Depot counter with school principal stamp.

name: Rajarshi Shahu Maharaj Foreign Scholarship for SC Students
department: Social Justice Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: SC Students Admitted to Top 100 QS World Ranked Foreign Universities
description: Full financial scholarship covering overseas higher education in Master's and PhD programs.
eligibility: SC candidate domiciled in Maharashtra with family income under INR 6,00,000.
benefits: 100% foreign university tuition fees, living maintenance allowance of USD 15,000/year, and airfare.
required_documents: Foreign admission letter, Caste Certificate, Domicile, Income certificate.
application_procedure: Apply on MahaDBT portal under Social Justice foreign scholarship section.

name: Ahilyabai Holkar Free Education Scheme for Girls (Girls Higher Secondary)
department: School Education Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Girl Students in Junior College (Class 11 and 12)
description: Waiver of examination and tuition fees for all girls enrolled in higher secondary junior college arts, science, and commerce streams.
eligibility: All girl students studying in Class 11 and 12 in Maharashtra government and aided schools.
benefits: 100% tuition and examination fee waiver.
required_documents: School ID, Domicile proof, Marksheet.
application_procedure: Fee waiver applied directly by school at admission.

name: Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Research Training and Human Development (SARTHI) Fellowships
department: SARTHI, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Maratha and Kunbi Community Research Scholars (M.Phil / Ph.D.)
description: Monthly research fellowship provided to scholars from Maratha and Kunbi communities pursuing doctoral studies.
eligibility: Enrolled in Ph.D. in recognized university in Maharashtra; belongs to Maratha/Kunbi community.
benefits: INR 31,000 to INR 35,000 per month fellowship stipend plus annual contingency grant.
required_documents: Caste Certificate, University Ph.D. registration letter, Synopsis, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply online on the SARTHI portal (sarthi-maharashtragov.in).

name: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Research and Training Institute (BARTI) Fellowship
department: BARTI, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste (SC) Ph.D. Research Scholars
description: Competitive research fellowships and MPSC/UPSC competitive exam coaching for SC youth in Maharashtra.
eligibility: SC student registered for Ph.D. or preparing for civil service exams.
benefits: Monthly fellowship equivalent to UGC-JRF (INR 31,000+) plus free civil services coaching stipend.
required_documents: Caste Certificate, Validity, Ph.D. Letter, Income proof.
application_procedure: Apply on BARTI portal (barti.maharashtra.gov.in).

name: Mahajyoti Fellowship for OBC, VJNT and SBC Students
department: Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Research Training & Human Development Institute (MAHAJYOTI)
target_beneficiaries: OBC, VJNT, and SBC Ph.D. Research Scholars and Exam Aspirants
description: Financial support and competitive examination preparation stipend for backward class youth.
eligibility: Belonging to OBC, VJNT, or SBC category in Maharashtra with valid non-creamy layer certificate.
benefits: INR 31,000/month Ph.D. fellowship and monthly stipend of INR 10,000 for UPSC/MPSC coaching.
required_documents: Caste Certificate, Non-Creamy Layer, Ph.D. Registration, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply on the Mahajyoti portal (mahajyoti.org.in).

name: Amrut Fellowship for Open Category EWS Youth (Maharashtra)
department: Maharashtra Research, Training and Human Development Institute (AMRUT)
target_beneficiaries: Economically Weaker Section (EWS) Youth from General Category
description: Empowerment, research fellowship, and entrepreneurial skill development for open category youth.
eligibility: Belonging to General/Open category holding valid Maharashtra EWS certificate.
benefits: Monthly fellowship of INR 31,000 for Ph.D. scholars and subsidized skill training courses.
required_documents: EWS Certificate, Domicile, Higher Degree proof.
application_procedure: Apply on AMRUT portal (amrutmaharashtra.org).

name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay Swayam Yojana (Tribal Hostel Food and Accommodation Allowance)
department: Tribal Development Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students Admitted to Higher Education without Govt Hostel
description: Cash allowance in lieu of hostel accommodation for ST students pursuing degree and diploma courses in cities.
eligibility: ST student domiciled in Maharashtra who did not secure admission in government tribal hostel. Studying in municipal corporation areas.
benefits: Direct financial assistance of INR 51,000 to INR 60,000 per year for lodging, boarding, and book charges.
required_documents: Tribe Certificate, College Bonafide, Rent Agreement / Hostel Receipt, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply on the Swayam Tribal portal (swayam.mahaonline.gov.in).

name: Dr. Punjabrao Deshmukh Organic Farming Mission (Maharashtra Jaivik Kheti)
department: Agriculture Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Farmers in Vidarbha and Marathwada Transitioning to Chemical-Free Organic Farming
description: Special state mission to convert 10 lakh hectares in Vidarbha into certified organic agriculture.
eligibility: Farmers in 6 distressed districts of Vidarbha and 8 districts of Marathwada.
benefits: Free organic certification, vermicompost unit subsidy of INR 10,000, and organic market stalls.
required_documents: 7/12 Extract, Group resolution, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply via District Superintending Agriculture Officer (SAO).

name: Maharashtra Bamboo Development Board Plantation Subsidy
department: Forest and Agriculture Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Farmers Cultivating Commercial Bamboo on Farmland
description: Incentivizing commercial bamboo cultivation as a drought-hardy cash crop with carbon credits.
eligibility: Landholding farmers in Maharashtra having cultivable fallow or farm bund land.
benefits: Subsidy of INR 70 per tissue-cultured bamboo sapling plus maintenance grants over 3 years.
required_documents: 7/12 Land Record, Soil test, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply via Maharashtra Bamboo Development Board (bamboo.maharashtra.gov.in).

name: Magel Tyala Shettale (Farm Pond on Demand Scheme)
department: Agriculture Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Landholding Farmers Seeking Rainwater Harvesting Ponds
description: Demand-driven farm pond scheme ensuring every applicant farmer receives grant to dig on-farm water reservoir.
eligibility: Farmer owning minimum 0.60 hectare land in Maharashtra with no prior farm pond grant.
benefits: Direct subsidy grant up to INR 50,000 to INR 75,000 for pond excavation and plastic lining.
required_documents: 7/12 Land Record, 8A Extract, Location geotag, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply online on the MahaDBT Farmer Portal.

name: Magel Tyala Saur Krushi Pump Yojana (Maharashtra Solar Pump on Demand)
department: MSEDCL / Energy Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Farmers with Water Source Lacking Electric Connection
description: Rapid-track solar agriculture pump installation for farmers on demand within 30 days of application.
eligibility: Farmer with open well, borewell, or river source lacking grid electricity.
benefits: Up to 90% subsidy for 3 HP, 5 HP, and 7.5 HP AC/DC solar submersible pumps.
required_documents: 7/12 Extract showing water source, Aadhaar, Caste certificate if SC/ST.
application_procedure: Apply on MSEDCL Solar Pump portal (mahadiscom.in/solar_MKSY).

name: Jalyukt Shivar Abhiyan 2.0 (Drought-Free Maharashtra Water Conservation)
department: Water Conservation Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Villages Facing Severe Groundwater Depletion and Drought
description: Community water harvesting, deepening of streams, construction of cement check dams, and farm bunding.
eligibility: Gram Panchayats and farmer clusters in identified water-stressed villages.
benefits: 100% government funding for nala deepening, percolation tanks, and groundwater recharge structures.
required_documents: Gram Panchayat resolution, village map.
application_procedure: Coordinated via District Collector and Ground Water Survey and Development Agency (GSDA).

name: Gokul Gram Mission (Indigenous Cattle Breed Improvement Scheme)
department: Department of Animal Husbandry, Dairying & Fisheries
target_beneficiaries: Dairy Farmers Rearing Indigenous Cow Breeds (Gir, Sahiwal, Red Sindhi, Khillari)
description: Promoting indigenous cattle conservation, artificial insemination, and breed multiplication farms.
eligibility: Dairy farmers, gaushalas, and breeders rearing native Indian cattle.
benefits: Up to 50% capital subsidy (up to INR 2 crore) for setting up 200-cow indigenous dairy breeding farms.
required_documents: Land ownership, DPR, Dairy experience certificate, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply via State Animal Husbandry Department.

name: Mukhyamantri Gram Sadak Yojana (MMGSY Maharashtra)
department: Rural Development Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Villages and Wadis Not Covered Under Central PMGSY
description: All-weather concrete and bitumen road connectivity to small rural hamlets and tribal wadis.
eligibility: Habitations with population 100 to 500 in Maharashtra.
benefits: 100% state-funded construction of blacktopped village link roads.
required_documents: Gram Panchayat representation.
application_procedure: Executed through Maharashtra Rural Road Development Association (MRRDA).

name: Arogya Vardhini Kendra (Ayushman Arogya Mandir Sub-Centers)
department: National Health Mission / Public Health Department
target_beneficiaries: Rural and Semi-Urban Residents Seeking Comprehensive Primary Care
description: Upgraded primary sub-centers delivering 12 packages of comprehensive primary healthcare, free medicines, and wellness.
eligibility: Open to all citizens in the catchment village.
benefits: Free screening for hypertension, diabetes, oral/breast/cervical cancers, free generic medicines, and wellness yoga sessions.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card or mobile number.
application_procedure: Walk in directly to the local Ayushman Arogya Mandir.

name: Balasaheb Thackeray Safe Motherhood Kit (Kanya Janma Kautuk Kit)
department: Public Health Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Newborn Babies and Mothers in Government Hospitals
description: Comprehensive baby care kit provided immediately upon institutional delivery in government civil hospitals.
eligibility: Mother giving birth in primary health centers, rural hospitals, or municipal hospitals in Maharashtra.
benefits: Free care kit valued at INR 2,000 containing baby clothes, baby mattress, mosquito net, thermometer, baby towel, and hygiene kit.
required_documents: Birth registration slip from hospital.
application_procedure: Handed over directly to mother in maternity ward before discharge.

name: Rashtriya Kishore Swasthya Karyakram (RKSK - Adolescent Health Clinics)
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Adolescents Aged 10 to 19 Years
description: Promoting holistic health, mental well-being, nutrition, substance misuse prevention, and menstrual hygiene among teenagers.
eligibility: All adolescents boys and girls aged 10-19 years.
benefits: Free peer educator counseling, sanitary napkin distribution at subsidized INR 1, and adolescent-friendly clinics (AFHC).
required_documents: None.
application_procedure: Visit adolescent health clinic in district hospital or school camps.

name: Mukhyamantri Vayoshri Yojana (Maharashtra Senior Citizen Cash Grant)
department: Social Justice Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Senior Citizens Aged 65 and Above in Maharashtra
description: Direct cash grant assistance to elderly citizens to purchase assistive appliances, glasses, hearing aids, and physical support gears.
eligibility: Resident of Maharashtra aged 65+. Annual family income below INR 2,00,000.
benefits: Direct one-time DBT cash grant of INR 3,000 deposited into senior citizen's bank account.
required_documents: Age proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID), Tahsildar Income Certificate, Domicile, Bank Passbook.
application_procedure: Apply on the MahaDBT or local Social Welfare Officer portal.

name: Kishori Shakti Yojana (Adolescent Girl Empowerment and Nutrition)
department: Women and Child Development Department
target_beneficiaries: Out-of-School Adolescent Girls Aged 11 to 18
description: Improving nutritional and health status of adolescent girls and equipping them with home-based trade skills.
eligibility: Adolescent girls belonging to low-income families not attending formal schooling.
benefits: Supplementary nutrition at Anganwadis, vocational skill training, and health hygiene education.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Anganwadi registration.
application_procedure: Register with local Anganwadi worker.

name: Udyam Registration Portal for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
department: Ministry of MSME, Government of India
target_beneficiaries: All Micro, Small, and Medium Business Enterprises in India
description: Official zero-cost paperless government registration portal conferring statutory MSME status and priority lending benefits.
eligibility: Any proprietor, partnership, LLP, private limited company engaged in manufacturing or services.
benefits: Free lifelong Udyam certificate with QR code, 1% interest rebate on bank loans, exemption on tender security deposits, and protection against delayed payments under MSME Samadhaan.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of proprietor/director, PAN Card, GSTIN (if applicable).
application_procedure: Register online at udyamregistration.gov.in without any fee.

name: MSME Samadhaan (Delayed Payment Monitoring System)
department: Ministry of MSME
target_beneficiaries: Micro and Small Enterprises Facing Non-Payment from Buyers
description: Online portal facilitating micro and small businesses to file delayed payment cases against corporate buyers and government departments.
eligibility: MSE holding valid Udyam Registration that has supplied goods or services and not received payment within 45 days.
benefits: Statutory right to compound interest at 3 times RBI bank rate for payment delayed beyond 45 days through Micro and Small Enterprise Facilitation Council (MSEFC).
required_documents: Udyam Certificate, Purchase Order copy, Invoice copy, Delivery challan.
application_procedure: File online application on samadhaan.msme.gov.in.

name: Maharashtra Electric Vehicle (EV) Subsidy Policy 2.0
department: Environment and Climate Change Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Citizens Purchasing Electric 2-Wheelers, 3-Wheelers, and 4-Wheelers
description: Promoting electric vehicle adoption and clean mobility across Maharashtra cities.
eligibility: Individual or commercial buyer purchasing registered battery electric vehicle in Maharashtra.
benefits: Direct demand incentive of up to INR 10,000 for 2-wheelers, INR 30,000 for 3-wheelers, and 100% exemption on road tax and registration fees.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Driving License, Vehicle Sale Invoice, RTO Registration.
application_procedure: Incentive deducted directly at dealership point or credited via transport portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Divyasha Scheme (Special Scholarship for Divyang Degree Students)
department: DEPwD, Ministry of Social Justice
target_beneficiaries: Differently-Abled Students in Recognized Technical and Professional Colleges
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for students with 40%+ disability studying engineering, medicine, management, and law.
eligibility: Disability percentage 40%+; annual family income under INR 3,00,000.
benefits: INR 4,000 per month maintenance allowance plus reimbursement of tuition fees up to INR 1,50,000 per year.
required_documents: UDID Card, College Admission Letter, Marksheet, Income Certificate.
application_procedure: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: MahaDBT Post-Matric Tuition Fee Concession for VJNT and SBC Students
department: VJNT, OBC and SBC Welfare Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: VJNT and SBC Students in Higher Education Courses
description: 100% tuition and exam fee reimbursement for students belonging to Vimukta Jati, Nomadic Tribes, and Special Backward Classes.
eligibility: Belonging to VJNT or SBC; family income up to INR 8,00,000. Admitted to higher education college in Maharashtra.
benefits: 100% tuition and examination fee waiver in government-aided and private un-aided institutions.
required_documents: Caste Certificate, Non-Creamy Layer, Domicile, Tahsildar Income Certificate, Marksheet.
application_procedure: Apply on mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in under VJNT OBC SBC department.

name: Mahadbt Open Category Merit Scholarship (EBC Girls)
department: Directorate of Higher Education, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Meritorious Girls in Arts, Commerce, Science
description: Merit scholarship for meritorious girl students in higher education.
eligibility: Minimum 60% in 12th; family income under INR 8 lakh.
benefits: INR 5,000 per year direct scholarship.
required_documents: Marksheet, Domicile, Income proof.
application_procedure: Apply on MahaDBT.

name: National Fellowship for Scheduled Tribe Students (NFST)
department: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
target_beneficiaries: ST Students Pursuing M.Phil and Ph.D.
description: Fellowship for ST students to pursue research degrees in Indian universities.
eligibility: ST student with valid university PhD admission.
benefits: INR 31,000 to INR 35,000 per month fellowship.
required_documents: Tribe certificate, PhD letter, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply on tribal.gov.in.

name: Prime Minister's Research Fellows (PMRF) Scheme
department: Ministry of Education / IITs / IISc
target_beneficiaries: Top Engineering and Science Research Scholars
description: Prestigious doctoral fellowship for cutting-edge technology and science research in IITs/IISc.
eligibility: B.Tech/M.Tech with CGPA > 8.0 or top GATE score admitted to IIT/IISc Ph.D.
benefits: INR 70,000 to INR 80,000 per month stipend plus INR 2 lakh annual research contingency.
required_documents: Academic transcripts, Research proposal.
application_procedure: Apply via pmrf.in during nomination rounds.

name: Maulana Azad National Fellowship for Minority Students (MANF Legacy)
department: Ministry of Minority Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Minority Students in M.Phil / Ph.D.
description: Research grant for religious minority scholars pursuing doctoral studies.
eligibility: Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi student with NET/JRF.
benefits: Monthly research stipend with contingency.
required_documents: Minority certificate, NET scorecard.
application_procedure: Apply on National Scholarship Portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra (PMKK - State-of-the-Art Model Centers)
department: NSDC / Ministry of Skill Development
target_beneficiaries: Youth Seeking Advanced Industry Training
description: State-of-the-art model skill training centers equipped with modern machinery across all districts.
eligibility: Youth aged 15-35 looking for industry certification.
benefits: Free vocational courses, smart classrooms, biometric attendance, placement linkage.
required_documents: Aadhaar, 10th/12th marksheets.
application_procedure: Walk into district PMKK center.

name: Mukhyamantri Gramin Peyjal Yojana (Rural Drinking Water Supply)
department: Water Supply and Sanitation Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Water-Scarcity Rural Habitations
description: Independent piped water supply schemes for rural habitations experiencing perennial tanker dependency.
eligibility: Village experiencing chronic summer water shortage.
benefits: 100% government funded community borewells, solar pumps, and distribution pipeline.
required_documents: Gram Panchayat proposal.
application_procedure: Sanctioned via Zilla Parishad water department.

name: Pradhan Mantri Khanij Kshetra Kalyan Yojana (PMKKKY - DMF)
department: Ministry of Mines
target_beneficiaries: Citizens in Mining Affected Areas (Chandrapur, Nagpur, Gadchiroli)
description: Welfare projects in mining-affected districts utilizing District Mineral Foundation (DMF) funds.
eligibility: Residents living in mining operational zones.
benefits: Free healthcare, piped drinking water, school infrastructure, and livelihood skills.
required_documents: Residence proof in mining block.
application_procedure: Managed by District Collector chaired DMF trust.

name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM - Pulses and Oilseeds)
department: Department of Agriculture
target_beneficiaries: Farmers Cultivating Pulses (Tur, Moong, Urad) and Oilseeds (Soybean)
description: Increasing production of pulses and oilseeds through subsidized high-yielding certified seeds.
eligibility: Cultivating pulses or soybean in Maharashtra.
benefits: 50% seed price subsidy and free farm implements like seed drills.
required_documents: 7/12 Extract, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply on MahaDBT Farmer Portal.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme (SHC)
department: Ministry of Agriculture
target_beneficiaries: All Cultivating Farmers
description: Testing agricultural soil nutrients and issuing customized fertilizer dosage advice cards.
eligibility: Any farmer cultivating land.
benefits: Free soil testing (12 chemical parameters) and customized Soil Health Card issued every 2 years.
required_documents: Soil sample from farm, 7/12 extract.
application_procedure: Contact village Agriculture Assistant or Krishi Sahayak.

name: Pradhan Mantri Gramin Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (PMGDISHA)
department: Ministry of Electronics and IT
target_beneficiaries: Digitally Illiterate Rural Citizens Aged 14 to 60
description: Empowering 6 crore rural households by making at least one member digitally literate.
eligibility: Rural resident lacking smartphone/computer skills. No member in family digitally literate.
benefits: 100% free 20-hour digital literacy training, hands-on computer and digital payment practice, government certificate.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Rural BPL/Ration Card.
application_procedure: Enroll at local village Common Service Center (CSC).

name: Mukhyamantri Shetkari Sahayata Vima (Farmer Disability Relief)
department: Agriculture Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Disabled and Injured Farmers
description: Emergency medical and financial compensation for farm accidents, snakebites, and electric shocks.
eligibility: Registered landholding farmer or family worker.
benefits: INR 1,00,000 for permanent disability; INR 50,000 for snakebite/electric shock treatment.
required_documents: Hospital discharge summary, Panchnama, 7/12.
application_procedure: Apply to Taluka Agriculture Officer within 30 days.

name: Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Protsahan Yojana (PMRPY - EPF Contribution)
department: Ministry of Labour and Employment
target_beneficiaries: New Formal Sector Employees with Salary Under 15000
description: Incentivizing employers to generate new jobs by paying the employer's full 12% EPF contribution.
eligibility: New employee joining registered establishment with salary up to INR 15,000.
benefits: Government pays full 12% employer provident fund (EPF + EPS) contribution for 3 years.
required_documents: Universal Account Number (UAN), Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Claimed directly by employer on EPFO portal.

name: MahaJyoti Free Tablet Scheme for Class 10/12 Backward Class Students
department: MahaJyoti, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Meritorious OBC/VJNT/SBC Students
description: Free computer tablets and 6GB daily internet data for students preparing for MHT-CET, JEE, and NEET.
eligibility: OBC/VJNT/SBC student enrolled in Class 11/12 in Maharashtra with family income under INR 8 lakh.
benefits: Free 10-inch Android Tablet with preloaded competitive exam coaching material and free data sim.
required_documents: Caste Certificate, 10th marksheet, Income certificate, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply online on mahajyoti.org.in.

name: Amrut Free Laptop Scheme for Open Category Civil Service Aspirants
department: AMRUT Institute, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: EWS General Category Students Preparing for UPSC/MPSC
description: Free laptop distribution and coaching stipend for competitive examination aspirants.
eligibility: General category candidate with valid EWS certificate preparing for state/central civil services.
benefits: Free laptop and INR 10,000 monthly study stipend during coaching.
required_documents: EWS Certificate, Degree Marksheet, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply on amrutmaharashtra.org.

name: BARTI Free UPSC/MPSC Residential Coaching Scheme
department: BARTI, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: SC Graduates Preparing for Civil Services
description: Free high-quality residential civil services coaching in Pune/Mumbai with monthly living stipend.
eligibility: SC graduate selected through state-wide competitive entrance test.
benefits: 100% free coaching, library, accommodation, and INR 10,000 per month stipend for 11 months.
required_documents: Caste Certificate, Graduation Degree, BARTI entrance rank card.
application_procedure: Apply on barti.maharashtra.gov.in.

name: SARTHI Free Competitive Coaching for Maratha Youth
department: SARTHI, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Maratha / Kunbi Graduates Preparing for Competitive Exams
description: Comprehensive coaching assistance for banking, railway, MPSC, and UPSC exams.
eligibility: Candidate belonging to Maratha/Kunbi category domiciled in Maharashtra.
benefits: Free coaching at empanelled coaching institutes plus monthly stipend of INR 8,000 to INR 10,000.
required_documents: Caste Certificate, Domicile, Degree.
application_procedure: Apply on sarthi-maharashtragov.in.

name: Mukhyamantri Teerth Darshan Yojana (Senior Citizen Pilgrimage Scheme)
department: Social Justice Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Senior Citizens Aged 60 and Above
description: Free pilgrimage tours to major religious and spiritual sites across India for senior citizens.
eligibility: Resident of Maharashtra aged 60+. Annual family income below INR 2,50,000. Medically fit for travel.
benefits: 100% free train travel, boarding, lodging, and guided tour to notified pilgrimage centers.
required_documents: Age proof, Tahsildar Income Certificate, Medical fitness certificate, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply through District Social Welfare Officer / Aaple Sarkar.

name: PM Mega Integrated Textile Region and Apparel (PM MITRA Parks)
department: Ministry of Textiles
target_beneficiaries: Textile Entrepreneurs, Garment Manufacturers, and Weavers
description: World-class integrated industrial infrastructure for textile manufacturing from spinning to garments.
eligibility: Textile and apparel manufacturing companies setting up units in notified PM MITRA park.
benefits: Capital support infrastructure grants up to INR 500 crore per park and concessional electricity tariffs.
required_documents: Project DPR, Corporate registration.
application_procedure: Apply through state industrial development agency (MIDC).

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS)
department: Ministry of Rural Development
target_beneficiaries: Rural Adult Household Members Demanding Manual Work
description: Statutory legal guarantee of 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to rural adult workers.
eligibility: Any adult member of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work.
benefits: Guaranteed 100 days work with daily wages (INR 273+ in Maharashtra) credited directly to bank account within 15 days.
required_documents: Gram Panchayat Job Card application, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Apply for work at Gram Panchayat office.

name: National Rural Livelihoods Mission - Umed Maharashtra (MSRLM)
department: Rural Development Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Rural Women in Self-Help Groups (SHGs)
description: Universal social and financial mobilization of rural poor women into community institutions.
eligibility: Rural women from vulnerable households.
benefits: Community Investment Fund, Revolving Fund of INR 15,000, and bank loans at 7% subsidized interest rate.
required_documents: SHG Membership, Bank Account.
application_procedure: Join or form SHG under village Gram Sangha.

name: Chief Minister's Fellowship Programme (Maharashtra Government)
department: Planning Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Young Graduates and Postgraduates Aged 21 to 26
description: Prestigious 1-year governance fellowship working directly with senior IAS officers and district collectors.
eligibility: Graduate with minimum 60% marks and 1 year work experience; age 21 to 26; fluent in Marathi and English.
benefits: Monthly stipend of INR 75,000 plus travel allowance of INR 5,000 per month.
required_documents: Degree Marksheet, Experience Certificate, Identity proof.
application_procedure: Selection through state-level online examination and interview on mahagovfellowship.in.

name: Aadhaar Enabled Payment System (AePS Doorstep Banking)
department: National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) / India Post Payments Bank
target_beneficiaries: Rural Citizens, Elderly, and Divyang Persons Needing Cash Withdrawal
description: Biometric doorstep banking allowing citizens to withdraw DBT pensions and subsidies using fingerprint.
eligibility: Any citizen with bank account seeded with Aadhaar.
benefits: Doorstep cash withdrawal up to INR 10,000, balance inquiry, and mini statement at village post office or Bank Mitra.
required_documents: Aadhaar number and biometric fingerprint.
application_procedure: Request local postman or Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) / CSC VLE.

name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK - Zero Expense Maternity Care)
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: All Pregnant Women and Sick Newborns in Public Hospitals
description: Entitling all pregnant women delivering in public health institutions to completely free and cashless healthcare.
eligibility: All pregnant women and sick neonates up to 1 year receiving treatment in government facilities.
benefits: 100% free delivery, C-section surgery, free drugs, free diagnostics, free blood transfusion, free food during stay, and free transport to and from hospital.
required_documents: MCP Card, Aadhaar.
application_procedure: Directly availed at admission in government hospitals.

name: Mukhyamantri Jal Swavalamban Abhiyan (Water Harvesting Grant)
department: Water Conservation Department
target_beneficiaries: Farmers and Communities Creating Check Dams and Ponds
description: Financial grants for community construction of small check dams, water percolation trenches, and farm bunds.
eligibility: Local farmers group or Village Water Committee.
benefits: Grants covering 80% to 100% cost of community water conservation structures.
required_documents: Village resolution, technical plan.
application_procedure: Submit to Taluka Agriculture Officer.

name: Divyang Marriage Incentive Scheme (Maharashtra)
department: Social Justice Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Persons with Disabilities Marrying Normal or Disabled Persons
description: Financial incentive grant to encourage mainstream social integration and marriage of disabled persons.
eligibility: One or both spouses domiciled in Maharashtra with 40%+ disability. Marriage legally registered.
benefits: One-time financial cash grant of INR 50,000 to INR 1,00,000 deposited into joint bank account.
required_documents: Marriage Certificate, Disability Certificate / UDID, Domicile, Joint Bank Passbook.
application_procedure: Apply to District Social Welfare Officer within 1 year of marriage.
